LmDEPsjxJH.one_liner: Mixed-initiative livestream assistant that jointly decides whether, when, to whom, and what to say, trained with MA-MSFT and SM-GSPO.
LmDEPsjxJH.problem: How AI systems should act, not only perceive, inside long-lasting multi-party livestreams, and selectively participate in a shared social environment, remains largely unexplored.
LmDEPsjxJH.method: LiveAssistant formulates livestream assistance as four coupled decisions (whether to act, when to act, whom to address, what to communicate), integrating native audio and video with comments, gifts, viewer dynamics, and room metadata at each chunk, and choosing to keep observing, update private memory, or respond. It is trained with a streaming trajectory engine that rebuilds replay timelines into decision trajectories, Marker-Aware Multiturn SFT (MA-MSFT), and Streaming Multiturn GSPO (SM-GSPO).
LmDEPsjxJH.key_idea: Treat each incoming stream chunk as a decision step choosing among observing, updating memory, or responding, learned from time-aligned replay trajectories via multiturn SFT and GSPO.
LmDEPsjxJH.evidence: Over 320 hours of training data built from replay timelines and a 39-hour human-verified benchmark spanning 8 regions and 7 languages; the remaining experimental results are cut off in the available abstract.

LaOUMzqRa7.one_liner: Lightweight adapter that compresses the most relevant omni-modal evidence at each step and injects it into a frozen decoder's embeddings.
LaOUMzqRa7.problem: Exposing the full omni-modal context uniformly at every step ignores that relevance is transient and sparse, so irrelevant signals distract the agent and errors compound into Sequential Distraction and irreversible trajectory drift.
LaOUMzqRa7.method: FocusGUI dynamically prioritizes multimodal channels against a step-specific decision reference, compresses the most relevant evidence into a compact latent, and injects it into the frozen decoder's embeddings to guide attention without changing its parameters. It trains from action supervision alone, without modality-relevance labels or backbone fine-tuning.
LaOUMzqRa7.key_idea: Score modality channels against a step-specific decision reference, compress the most relevant evidence into a latent, and add it to the frozen decoder's input embeddings.
LaOUMzqRa7.evidence: Four omni-modal backbones, compared with the frozen backbone and with the strongest existing enhancement method.
LaOUMzqRa7.claimed_gains: Across four omni-modal backbones, it raises overall Type Match by +33.2 and Exact Match by 3.0x over the frozen backbone on average, and Type Match by +30.1 over the strongest existing enhancement method.

zvV9P60rcU.one_liner: On-policy distillation that calibrates token-level KL with a Spatial Divergence between student grounding proposals and teacher-supported evidence
zvV9P60rcU.problem: Token-level KL treats spatially equivalent region descriptions as distinct token serializations, giving biased learning signals for grounding in on-policy distillation of vision-language models.
zvV9P60rcU.method: MixOPD measures the geometric discrepancy between each on-policy student grounding proposal and a teacher-supported evidence distribution estimated via Teacher-Forced Constrained Search, and uses it to spatially calibrate the token-level KL objective. It plugs into standard and entropy-aware OPD frameworks.
zvV9P60rcU.key_idea: Calibrate the token-level KL with a Spatial Divergence between student grounding proposals and a teacher evidence distribution obtained from Teacher-Forced Constrained Search.
zvV9P60rcU.evidence: Experiments on vision-centric reasoning with large vision-language models show gains over standard and entropy-aware OPD, with comparisons to post-training baselines and recent alternatives, inference latency and training stability; datasets are not stated.

cnkL9N9iiM.one_liner: Recurrent-depth accuracy follows a CDF of task circuit depth, giving a scaling law that predicts held-out model scale.
cnkL9N9iiM.problem: There is no mechanistic account of how test-time compute (iterations of a weight-shared block) in recurrent-depth language models relates to the serial depth of the task.
cnkL9N9iiM.method: They derive a law in which latent accuracy is a reliability-weighted cumulative distribution function of circuit depth, with per-step reliability growing with model size. They test its three falsifiable predictions on a compute-optimal ladder trained from scratch (19M-121M non-embedding parameters) across three reasoning domains.
cnkL9N9iiM.key_idea: Model latent accuracy as a reliability-weighted CDF over a task's circuit depth (serial steps of its reference computation), with per-step reliability increasing with model size.
cnkL9N9iiM.evidence: Law fit on smaller ladder models predicts the held-out largest model; the released Huginn-3.5B is tested on GSM8K, ProsQA and SVAMP; recurrent depth is compared with continuous-thought positions.
cnkL9N9iiM.claimed_gains: R-squared of 0.93 for predicting the held-out largest model's depth-accuracy curve, R-squared of at least 0.99 for Huginn-3.5B 29x beyond the ladder, and R-squared of 0.96 for geometric decay of GSM8K accuracy with gold-solution depth.

mqfod2aQXG.one_liner: VibeEdit edits images from spatial marks and short notes drawn on the canvas, using a Qwen-Image-Edit backbone.
mqfod2aQXG.problem: In text-guided image editing, describing the intended object or region is cumbersome, especially when several objects look alike.
mqfod2aQXG.method: Users place spatial marks and optional notes on the image, forming a canvas instruction, and VibeEdit adapts Qwen-Image-Edit with layer-decoupled conditioning that separately encodes the source image and the canvas instruction. Training uses 1.55 million source-target pairs with region-weighted SFT followed by rubric-guided reinforcement learning.
mqfod2aQXG.key_idea: Condition the editor on source image and canvas instruction through separately encoded, layer-decoupled inputs, then train with region-weighted SFT and rubric-guided RL.
mqfod2aQXG.evidence: Evaluated on an independently constructed, human-curated benchmark of 419 cases emphasizing target selection among similar objects.
mqfod2aQXG.claimed_gains: VLM rubric score of 79.9 and outside-region PSNR of 32.8 dB, compared with 67.4 and 24.0 dB for FireRed.

PgLPm0yLlI.one_liner: VGGT-Diff routes VGGT-Ω geometry latents into a pretrained video diffusion model for sparse-view novel view synthesis.
PgLPm0yLlI.problem: Reconstruction-based novel view synthesis preserves observed geometry but struggles to synthesize unseen regions, while diffusion-based methods rely on implicit source-to-query correspondence.
PgLPm0yLlI.method: Each visual token is tied to a 3D point and confidence, and a confidence-aware Visual Geometry Router (VGR) with depth-weighted residual refinement turns these into query-aligned latent conditions that guide joint target-view denoising. Point-Track Residual Consistency (PTRC) regularizes predicted-clean latent residuals along reliable 3D tracks.
PgLPm0yLlI.key_idea: Route confidence-weighted, 3D-point-tagged geometry tokens into query-aligned conditions for a video diffusion model, and regularize latent residuals along reliable 3D tracks.
PgLPm0yLlI.evidence: Experiments on interpolation and extrapolation under different viewpoint difficulties; the abstract names no datasets or baselines.
PgLPm0yLlI.claimed_gains: not stated; only a qualitative claim of competitive performance across interpolation and extrapolation.

MfjkNRJYDT.one_liner: UOT-GF relaxes only the real-data marginal in unbalanced optimal transport while keeping generated samples fully transported, for one-step generation.
MfjkNRJYDT.problem: In one-step drifting models, balanced mini-batch optimal transport forces exact mass matching, making the estimated transport field sensitive to the composition of the real-data batch.
MfjkNRJYDT.method: UOT-GF (Unbalanced Optimal Transport Gradient Flow) keeps the generated-sample marginal fixed and relaxes only the real-data marginal when computing the mini-batch transport field.
MfjkNRJYDT.key_idea: Let mass on real samples adapt while every generated sample stays fully transported, reducing sensitivity of the transport field to real-batch composition.
MfjkNRJYDT.evidence: Controlled ablations across six feature-space metrics, and ImageNet-256 experiments at DiT-B/2, L/2, and XL/2 against the balanced W-Flow baseline.
MfjkNRJYDT.claimed_gains: At DiT-B/2 on ImageNet-256, FID improves from 1.53 to 1.46 over the balanced W-Flow baseline, and scaling the same recipe yields 1.34 at L/2 and 1.22 at XL/2.

cESlRJI2Yk.one_liner: CoPE adds an auxiliary loss training the policy to forecast K future actions from earlier history on successful trajectories.
cESlRJI2Yk.problem: Agentic RL learns from a terminal scalar reward and leaves intermediate supervision unused, while next-observation prediction is ill-suited because observations such as HTML pages and terminal logs are long and noisy.
cESlRJI2Yk.method: On successful on-policy trajectories, CoPE trains the policy backbone on an action plan containing the current action and K future actions predicted from earlier history, without the intervening observations.
cESlRJI2Yk.key_idea: Forecast future actions, not observations, from earlier history on success-conditioned trajectories, so acting and forecasting share one backbone and match the policy-optimization horizon.
cESlRJI2Yk.evidence: Five benchmarks (ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, WebShop, tau2-bench, AppWorld) against GRPO and observation-prediction baselines, with an analysis showing the loss optimizes success-conditioned action marginals.

pKH3ux14Ei.one_liner: Shows task-unrelated prompts can steer LLM behavior and improve benchmark scores, using a black-box search to find them.
pKH3ux14Ei.problem: Prompt sensitivity has been studied through task-relevant instructions, demonstrations, or reasoning cues, but not whether semantically unrelated prompts can steer model behavior.
pKH3ux14Ei.method: The authors define spurious prompts, which are semantically unrelated to the task, and propose a simple black-box search procedure for discovering them.
pKH3ux14Ei.key_idea: Search black-box over task-unrelated prompt text to find strings that systematically shift model outputs, either improving accuracy or inducing specific unintended behaviors.
pKH3ux14Ei.evidence: Reasoning and question-answering benchmarks with models from 0.8B to 27B parameters across three model families, compared with standard prompting baselines and task-aware prompt optimization.
pKH3ux14Ei.claimed_gains: Spurious prompts can improve performance, often matching or outperforming standard prompting baselines and task-aware prompt optimization (no numbers stated).

eNu6B1DJvr.one_liner: Introduces a 3D benchmark for cross-episode embodied multi-agent collaboration and a reasoning method over an evolving environment.
eNu6B1DJvr.problem: Existing embodied multi-agent benchmarks isolate episodes, and memory benchmarks study history within single tasks, leaving interdependent cross-episode collaboration underexplored.
eNu6B1DJvr.method: The Tapestry Benchmark organizes tasks into continuous streams in evolving 3D environments. Tapestry Reasoning views the evolving environment as a tapestry woven from distributed observations, actions, state transitions, and execution outcomes (abstract truncated).
eNu6B1DJvr.key_idea: Treat the evolving environment as a tapestry assembled from distributed observations, actions, state transitions, and execution outcomes that agents accumulate, share, and reuse across episodes.
eNu6B1DJvr.evidence: A controlled 3D benchmark of continuous task streams with cross-episode continuity dependencies; experimental details are cut off in the available abstract.

hQx3Hvs2Bu.one_liner: Test-time scaling for VLA models that steers flow sampling with an adapted verifier's reward gradients and routes by risk.
hQx3Hvs2Bu.problem: VLA models degrade under test-time distribution shift, and existing test-time scaling only selects among completed action candidates while the generation process and the verifier stay fixed.
hQx3Hvs2Bu.method: FlowShift keeps the VLA backbone frozen and adds a Test-Time Adaptive Task-Progress Verifier that adapts latent prompts via self-supervised state prediction. Verifier-Guided Stochastic Flow Sampling converts selected ODE updates into SDE transitions steered by reward gradients, with scalar rewards selecting particles, and a Risk-Aware Router models multi-timestep flow features to prevent excessive shifts.
hQx3Hvs2Bu.key_idea: Convert selected ODE flow updates into verifier-guided SDE transitions using reward gradients from a test-time-adapted verifier, and gate the shift with a risk-aware router.
hQx3Hvs2Bu.evidence: Experimental evidence is not visible in the truncated abstract; the keyword points to robotic manipulation.

gIBoM6mOIQ.one_liner: GeoWAM pretrains a world action model to forecast future point-based scene geometry, then predicts ego trajectories with a geometry-conditioned head.
gIBoM6mOIQ.problem: Pixel-space world action models entangle geometry and motion with appearance, texture and illumination, forcing 3D transformations to be inferred from 2D observations.
gIBoM6mOIQ.method: GeoWAM is pretrained to forecast future scene geometry rather than future images, and a geometry-conditioned action head uses the learned geometric dynamics to predict future ego-trajectories.
gIBoM6mOIQ.key_idea: Replace future-image prediction with future point-based geometry forecasting as the world-model objective, then condition the action head on the learned geometric representation.
gIBoM6mOIQ.evidence: Experiments on NAVSIM v2 and a second benchmark (name truncated in the abstract) comparing against image-based alternatives.
gIBoM6mOIQ.claimed_gains: Outperforms image-based alternatives, with an EPDMS of 90.2 on NAVSIM v2 and a combined EPDMS of 36.6 on a second benchmark whose name is truncated.

TSIMde19fH.one_liner: PAC uses a frozen pretrained GeoPT's weights and distance field to bound where inverse shape optimization may drift and deform.
TSIMde19fH.problem: In inverse shape design the optimizer descends the gradients of a frozen neural surrogate, so the search leaves the region where the surrogate has evidence and claims gains no data can verify; engineers currently bridge this trust gap by hand-specifying deformation regions and limits.
TSIMde19fH.method: Physics-Aware Constraints reads two constraints from a frozen GeoPT pretrained on geometry lifted with synthetic dynamics: the model's weights bound how far optimization may drift off the family response manifold, and its distance field bounds where deformation is admissible, both calibrated on the family without labels.
TSIMde19fH.key_idea: A model pretrained to perceive geometry through synthetic physical response supervises the search rather than driving it, bounding drift via its weights and admissible deformation via its distance field.
TSIMde19fH.evidence: Four CAE families, including ship hulls with an analytic oracle verifying wave drag, and analyses separating scale selectivity (distance field) from detection sensitivity (physics-lifted pretraining).
TSIMde19fH.claimed_gains: A 64% wave drag reduction on ship hulls verified by an analytic oracle, while keeping optimization inside the trust band at little cost to legitimate gains.

OU5l8NvsOq.one_liner: WorldSculpt adapts a single-object generative prior with multi-view conditioning to generate cluttered scenes as hundreds of object meshes.
OU5l8NvsOq.problem: Existing compositional methods target simple scenes, so generating large, densely cluttered scenes as individually editable object meshes remains hard.
OU5l8NvsOq.method: WorldSculpt uses canonical-space multi-view conditioning, training-time augmentation, and object-wise scene composition, finetuned entirely on single-object data, to generate hundreds of mutually occluding objects as complete, spatially aligned meshes in a shared world frame. The authors also introduce a photorealistic cluttered-scene benchmark with per-object annotations.
OU5l8NvsOq.key_idea: Condition a single-object generative prior on canonical-space multi-view observations and compose scenes object by object, with no scene-level training.
OU5l8NvsOq.evidence: Evaluation on a new photorealistic benchmark of densely cluttered scenes with per-object annotations, plus conversion of Marble 3DGS worlds into compositional scenes.
OU5l8NvsOq.claimed_gains: Superior geometric accuracy and observation alignment over prior approaches; no numbers are stated.

qwVJuNWqkO.one_liner: QNMGAD combines prototype and residual-pattern quantization with granularity-conditioned normalizing flows to detect node, edge, and subgraph anomalies.
qwVJuNWqkO.problem: Multi-granularity graph anomaly detection methods use a unified representation space across granularities and overlook the distinct characteristics and anomaly patterns of each granularity, which hurts identification.
qwVJuNWqkO.method: Prototype quantization captures discriminative semantics across granularities and residual-pattern quantization extracts latent semantics within a granularity. Normalizing flows conditioned on granularity prototypes model the distribution of normal patterns, and density estimation flags anomalies.
qwVJuNWqkO.key_idea: Condition normalizing flows on quantized granularity prototypes to model normal patterns per granularity, and flag anomalies by low estimated density.
qwVJuNWqkO.evidence: Experiments against baselines on node, edge, and subgraph anomaly detection; datasets and baselines are not named in the abstract.

10hgMQcDFl.one_liner: A Shell Game video task tests whether world models track hidden state, finding generalization requires revisable, expressive recurrent state.
10hgMQcDFl.problem: Visual fidelity does not show that a video world model maintains the hidden world state, and the pixel-based diffusion loss does not force generated frames to hold unseen quantities such as the ball position.
10hgMQcDFl.method: An action-conditioned video Shell Game, a visual analogue of S5 state tracking, separates rendering from compositing the unobserved state; the authors train standard backbones (bidirectional and autoregressive Transformers, Mamba, linear attention) on 5-swap chains and test longer chains. They then study which architectural properties enable learning the rule.
10hgMQcDFl.key_idea: State tracking generalizes only when state is revisable across chunks and the update is expressive enough to apply a swap, e.g. linear attention with negative transition eigenvalues.
10hgMQcDFl.evidence: Controlled Shell Game experiments with bidirectional and autoregressive Transformers, Mamba, and linear attention trained on 5-swap chains and tested on longer chains, including with more denoising steps.

7kXAUvQqkf.one_liner: PhiZero predicts future world evolution as a discrete physical-language sequence, then renders it into video.
7kXAUvQqkf.problem: Physical world models usually predict future videos directly in pixel space, leaving world dynamics implicit within high-dimensional visual predictors.
7kXAUvQqkf.method: PhiZero learns a compact discrete representation of world-state transitions, called physical language, from in-the-wild videos through self-supervision. It follows a reason-then-render paradigm, first inferring future evolution as a physical-language sequence and then rendering the transitions into videos.
7kXAUvQqkf.key_idea: Learn a compact discrete representation of world-state transitions by self-supervision, predict future evolution as a sequence in it, then render that sequence into video.
7kXAUvQqkf.evidence: Experiments across generation and understanding benchmarks (not named), plus demonstrations of action-conditioned simulation and cross-embodiment and sim-to-real transfer.

r5xM0GQW4G.one_liner: Reconstructs 3DGS street scenes from Google Street View panoramas using structural losses, split suppression, and a session appearance adapter.
r5xM0GQW4G.problem: Street View panoramas are sparse in camera centers, leaving depth weakly constrained and producing floaters under extrapolated views, and they differ in appearance across capture sessions, which standard photometric optimizers compensate for with wrong geometry.
r5xM0GQW4G.method: SplatAnywhere adds structural supervision losses in regions that Structure from Motion under-represents, suppresses Gaussian splits where views disagree (reducing the number of Gaussians while improving geometry), and uses a session appearance adapter to absorb photometric differences across capture sessions.
r5xM0GQW4G.key_idea: Add structural supervision where SfM is sparse, suppress splitting where views disagree, and absorb cross-session color differences in an appearance adapter instead of in geometry.
r5xM0GQW4G.evidence: not stated; the experimental section is cut off in the available abstract.

rW0pCo2qvE.one_liner: Multi-shot video generator that jointly trains next-shot generation and subject reconstruction from memory, with dual-query memory retrieval.
rW0pCo2qvE.problem: Memory-conditioned autoregressive video generators optimize memory conditioning or selection without explicitly supervising use of identity-critical evidence in memory, so subject appearance drifts over time.
rW0pCo2qvE.method: Memento jointly trains next-shot generation and subject reconstruction, recovering target appearances from historical memory and subject descriptions. A dual-query memory uses story-conditioned queries for long-range subject evidence and shot-conditioned queries for short-range context, and a subject-aware cinematic data pipeline aligns story, shot, and reconstruction captions.
rW0pCo2qvE.key_idea: Supervise identity grounding by reconstructing subject appearance from historical memory alongside next-shot generation, with separate story-level and shot-level memory queries.
rW0pCo2qvE.evidence: Experiments on subject consistency, particularly across scene transitions; further details are cut off in the available abstract.

eyBA3tXjI0.one_liner: Animates unrigged meshes by diffusing motion in a per-mesh Laplacian basis, aligned across identities through jointly estimated adapters.
eyBA3tXjI0.problem: Native 4D mesh generation must animate an unrigged mesh from an action condition while preserving vertex indexing and connectivity, and sharing motion across independently meshed inputs requires common learning coordinates that retain reconstruction on each topology.
eyBA3tXjI0.method: A fixed native Laplacian basis computed from each mesh represents motion as compact coefficient trajectories decoded directly on the input vertices. Jointly estimated adapters align native spectral coordinates using partial surface correspondences, motion diffusion is conditioned on action and input morphology, and the decoded sequence is refined to preserve local details.
eyBA3tXjI0.key_idea: Represent motion in each mesh's native Laplacian basis and align those bases across identities with jointly estimated adapters, giving shared coordinates without a learned mesh decoder.
eyBA3tXjI0.evidence: Experiments in separate animal and human domains on new identities, with ablations of shared spectral coordinates and morphology conditioning (the abstract is cut off).
eyBA3tXjI0.claimed_gains: not stated; the abstract only claims better motion accuracy and surface quality on new identities than compared methods, without numbers.

WvJG4cT34f.one_liner: Memory-augmented agent that builds an album memory graph and self-evolving search skills for personal photo retrieval.
WvJG4cT34f.problem: Embedding-based retrieval ranks photos independently, but personal album queries often identify targets through contextual clues found in other photos.
WvJG4cT34f.method: Mneme's Album Memory Graph links grounded photo evidence, recurring visual instances, and overlapping episodic contexts, while Self-Evolving Search Skills are induced from same-query success-failure trajectory contrasts on auxiliary tasks. Inference combines memory-guided reconstruction with memory-independent evidence search and reconciles candidates against raw images and metadata.
WvJG4cT34f.key_idea: Reconstruct cross-photo relations as a persistent relational memory graph and refine reusable search guidance from success-failure trajectory contrasts.
WvJG4cT34f.evidence: Experiments on DISBench and CamRoll with two backbones against retrieval and memory-augmented baselines, plus ablations.

N1PhdtojjK.one_liner: Detects AI-generated images by learning from per-patch score changes between two mixed views of aligned real-generated pairs.
N1PhdtojjK.problem: In mixed views that replace real patches with generated ones, self-attention lets patches interact, so each patch feature no longer reflects its own source and a per-patch source label is an imprecise target.
N1PhdtojjK.method: Relative Patch Response Learning (PRL) compares the same patch across two mixed views of an aligned pair and learns from its patch response, the change of its score between views. A relative response objective measures source-changed patches against source-unchanged ones, and a reference coherence objective (abstract truncated) supplies a reliable reference for the shift.
N1PhdtojjK.key_idea: Supervise the change in a patch's score between two mixed views, using source-unchanged patches as the reference for the contextual shift, instead of absolute per-patch source labels.
N1PhdtojjK.evidence: not stated; the abstract is truncated before the experiments, and only the goal of generalizing to unseen generators and unseen perturbations is given.

OkFxN6qTlf.one_liner: WAM-Bench is a real-world closed-loop benchmark of 37 hours of driving video for open-ended instruction following by VLA models.
OkFxN6qTlf.problem: End-to-end driving benchmarks provide only two predefined instructions (go straight and turn), leaving VLA instruction following unexplored.
OkFxN6qTlf.method: The benchmark pairs 37 hours of driving videos with human-reviewed open-ended instructions over 13 action classes, with a baseline evaluation framework and a new instruction-following metric (IF) for closed-loop testing.
OkFxN6qTlf.key_idea: Evaluate VLA driving models in closed loop on open-ended, human-reviewed instructions, scored with a dedicated instruction-following metric.
OkFxN6qTlf.evidence: Experiments with representative VLA baselines on the standard split, long-horizon execution, changed instructions, and out-of-distribution instructions.
OkFxN6qTlf.claimed_gains: not stated; the abstract reports that open-ended instruction following remains challenging for current VLA models.

WnCs6ROTaZ.one_liner: Drop-Then-Recovery removes transformer blocks ranked by one-shot GateProbe sensitivity, then fine-tunes to test how redundant VLA components are.
WnCs6ROTaZ.problem: VLAs inherit oversized language backbones from VLMs, and how much of a VLA is actually necessary for closed-loop control is unknown.
WnCs6ROTaZ.method: Drop-Then-Recovery removes selected blocks from a pretrained VLA and fine-tunes the result to measure whether the removed capacity was needed. GateProbe is a one-shot virtual-gate sensitivity metric that ranks blocks by their contribution to the downstream action loss.
WnCs6ROTaZ.key_idea: Rank blocks by one-shot virtual-gate sensitivity of the action loss, remove them, and measure post-removal recoverability by fine-tuning.
WnCs6ROTaZ.evidence: Multiple VLA architectures, manipulation benchmarks including LIBERO, and real-robot industrial scenarios.
WnCs6ROTaZ.claimed_gains: On LIBERO, removing half of the LLM blocks improves OpenVLA-OFT from 95.0% to 98.3% under the same fine-tuning budget; language backbones are highly redundant while vision and action pathways tolerate removal poorly.

mMNFYaiV9F.one_liner: SWEeper-Bench tests whether agents find and fix interaction-dependent bugs in 200 open-source web apps, judged by an agentic browser verifier.
mMNFYaiV9F.problem: Existing coding benchmarks assume bugs are already identified, leaving agents' ability to find failures that appear only after multi-step interaction unevaluated.
mMNFYaiV9F.method: The benchmark has 200 tasks built from real bug fixes in 200 open-source web applications. Each task gives only the codebase and an open-ended request, agents must design interactive tests, and an agentic verifier judges each repair by what a user would observe in the browser.
mMNFYaiV9F.key_idea: Hide the bug and judge repairs by user-visible browser behavior, so agents must discover failures through self-designed interactive tests.
mMNFYaiV9F.evidence: Evaluation of frontier coding agents on 200 tasks, with a stage-by-stage analysis of agent trajectories.
mMNFYaiV9F.claimed_gains: The best of 19 frontier agents passes only 59.0% of tasks (the TL;DR says 15 agents), with the main bottleneck being identification of the buggy behavior.

usA5rWHcwQ.one_liner: HoRA generates multimodal LoRA matrix entries on the fly from per-modality hashed parameter buckets instead of storing explicit low-rank factors.
usA5rWHcwQ.problem: Explicit multimodal LoRA ties adaptation capacity to the dimensions of the low-rank factors, so modality-wise parameter allocation is hard to control once rank is fixed.
usA5rWHcwQ.method: HoRA builds low-rank adaptations through feature-hashing-based implicit parameterization, producing matrix entries from compact parameter buckets, with an independent bucket size for each modality. The authors prove unbiased reconstruction, a collision-dependent approximation bound, and a convergence bound depending on modality-specific bucket sizes.
usA5rWHcwQ.key_idea: Replace explicit LoRA factors with hashed parameter buckets sized separately per modality, which sets modality-wise adaptation capacity at a fixed rank.
usA5rWHcwQ.evidence: Theory on hashing reconstruction and convergence, plus experiments across diverse multimodal benchmarks (not named in the abstract excerpt).
usA5rWHcwQ.claimed_gains: Competitive or superior performance with comparable or fewer trainable parameters; no numbers stated.

JbJE3PUxmS.one_liner: VLM-driven procedural 3D world generation combining symbolically constrained asset generation with deterministic frustum-guided grid placement.
JbJE3PUxmS.problem: VLM code generation yields simple 3D assets, photorealistic procedural systems need manual development, and existing VLM-guided methods are limited to predefined factories and APIs.
JbJE3PUxmS.method: Symbolically Constrained Asset Generation uses existing procedural algorithms to create photorealistic assets that stay editable and seed-diverse. A text-to-world pipeline adds semantic scene planning and Deterministic Frustum-Guided Grid Placement for object placement, population and animation.
JbJE3PUxmS.key_idea: Constrain VLM-written asset code with existing procedural algorithms, and place objects through a deterministic frustum-guided grid after semantic scene planning.
JbJE3PUxmS.evidence: 100 object and 20 scene generation tasks scored on four perceptual metrics, plus diversity analysis, ablations and human preference evaluations.
JbJE3PUxmS.claimed_gains: not stated (abstract reports improvements across four perceptual metrics without numbers).

6ogkMG3XXb.one_liner: UAV vision-language tracker conditioned throughout on camera geometry (altitude, pitch, focal length) at representation, propagation, and decoding.
6ogkMG3XXb.problem: UAV vision-language trackers rely on learned features to implicitly handle imaging changes from altitude, gimbal pitch, and focal length, which may reduce reliability across geometry settings.
6ogkMG3XXb.method: GeoVLT applies Geometry-Conditioned Representation within each frame, Geometry-Adaptive Temporal Propagation across frames, and Geometry-Conditioned Decoding for coordinate prediction. The authors build the GeoUAV dataset with vision, language, and camera geometry, and train a lightweight estimator on it to predict geometry from first-frame features for public benchmarks that lack it.
6ogkMG3XXb.key_idea: Feed physical camera geometry into the target representation, temporal propagation, and decoding stages instead of leaving imaging changes to learned features.
6ogkMG3XXb.evidence: Evaluation on the new GeoUAV dataset (GeoUAV100) and on public UAV benchmarks using estimated camera geometry.
6ogkMG3XXb.claimed_gains: GeoVLT reaches 69.69% AUC on GeoUAV100; the comparison figure is cut off in the provided abstract.

v8BSZRjnCr.one_liner: FRBench benchmark plus HTML-based data synthesis and a two-stage OPSD-then-GRPO training method for fine-grained text-rich image understanding.
v8BSZRjnCr.problem: Existing benchmarks are limited in scope and cannot comprehensively evaluate whether multimodal LLMs perceive textual details in long visual contexts.
v8BSZRjnCr.method: A synthesis pipeline converts source images to HTML and edits query-related evidence regions to raise local information density, yielding the FRBench benchmark and a training set. FineRich trains in two stages: a prefix-guided region-to-image OPSD stage for basic fine-grained text recognition, then multi-task GRPO across diverse TIU tasks.
v8BSZRjnCr.key_idea: Render text-rich images from HTML with query-related evidence regions edited for density, then train with a prefix-guided region-to-image OPSD stage followed by multi-task GRPO.
v8BSZRjnCr.evidence: FRBench covers 90 combinations of six image types, three granularity levels and five task domains; a 34K-example training set is built automatically; results are reported on FRBench, other fine-grained TIU benchmarks and general OCR benchmarks.
v8BSZRjnCr.claimed_gains: No numbers stated; the abstract claims leading performance on FRBench and improved performance on other fine-grained TIU and general OCR benchmarks.

nHsLDTjlZ5.one_liner: Distillation hashing that selects reliable teacher bits via entropy and polarity analysis and filters contrastive alignment to purify semantics.
nHsLDTjlZ5.problem: Unsupervised multimodal hashing has excessive parameters and redundant code bits, and standard distillation forces the student to mimic teacher representations that contain noise and errors.
nHsLDTjlZ5.method: A dual-granularity purification: at the bit level, an information-theoretic reliability module based on secondary clustering separates discriminative bits from redundant noise using entropy and polarity analysis; at the semantic level, a filtered bidirectional contrastive objective masks false-positive alignment and false-negative repulsion, plus an intra-student contrastive task to offset sparse supervision.
nHsLDTjlZ5.key_idea: Treat the teacher as imperfect: distill only bits judged reliable by entropy and polarity and only contrastive pairs that pass a filter, rather than mimicking the whole teacher.
nHsLDTjlZ5.evidence: Experiments on three benchmark datasets (not named in the available text) are said to show that the method purifies distilled knowledge and gives a lightweight model.

5VThYiZrua.one_liner: Decision-coordinate framework normalizes mean accuracy (mA) comparisons in pedestrian attribute recognition via validation-set isotonic calibration.
5VThYiZrua.problem: Native mA comparisons in pedestrian attribute recognition can mix different operating policies, because label-imbalance interventions change score meaning and inference thresholds vary.
5VThYiZrua.method: A decision-coordinate framework derives objective-implied coordinates for identifiable loss and sampling components and estimates each trained predictor's score-space coordinates with validation-set isotonic calibration, adding objective and realized-policy normalization toward the common balanced-accuracy target.
5VThYiZrua.key_idea: Map each predictor's scores to common decision coordinates using isotonic calibration on validation data, so mA compares methods at the same balanced-accuracy operating point.
5VThYiZrua.evidence: A paper-and-code audit of PAR methods, controlled methods with ResNet-50 and ViT-B/16 backbones on RAP, and published PAR methods, holding each predictor fixed across evaluation views with disjoint test data.
5VThYiZrua.claimed_gains: On RAP, the gap between inverse-prior reweighting and unweighted binary cross-entropy falls from 8.99 to 0.12 percentage points with ResNet-50 and from 8.16 to 0.28 with ViT-B/16 under realized-policy normalization.

hjIu8gtqQO.one_liner: Training-free video token compression that keeps tokens poorly predicted from a memory of anchor frames.
hjIu8gtqQO.problem: Training-free video VLM compression scores each token on its own (saliency, diversity, neighbor similarity), ignoring what a token adds beyond the context already kept.
hjIu8gtqQO.method: PreViC picks a few temporally distinct anchor frames as visual memory and ranks every other token by how poorly its nearest anchors predict it, keeping the least predictable ones. It is prompt-agnostic and runs before the language model.
hjIu8gtqQO.key_idea: Keep a visual token exactly when a compact memory of anchor frames fails to predict it, ranking tokens by nearest-anchor prediction error.
hjIu8gtqQO.evidence: Three checkpoints, five retain ratios and four benchmarks, including LLaVA-OneVision 7B and another 7B model.
hjIu8gtqQO.claimed_gains: Highest four-benchmark average accuracy of any method at 12 of 15 settings; on LLaVA-OneVision 7B it holds the uncompressed model's accuracy with 50% of the visual tokens.

EIoFLnJ7AE.one_liner: Allocates teacher supervision in on-policy distillation by grounding in video evidence and student-learnable corrections for dynamic spatial reasoning.
EIoFLnJ7AE.problem: Standard on-policy distillation treats all reasoning positions uniformly, ignoring whether a prediction is grounded in spatiotemporal evidence and whether the correction is learnable by the student.
EIoFLnJ7AE.method: G2-OPD measures grounding with counterfactual video probes (sensitivity to visual content, temporal order and motion) and graspability from teacher-student disagreement plus teacher support for the student's leading candidates. A regularized rule combines the two signals to redistribute full-vocabulary reverse-KL supervision.
EIoFLnJ7AE.key_idea: Reweight reverse-KL distillation per position by counterfactual-probe grounding and disagreement-based graspability, with a regularizer against excessive concentration.
EIoFLnJ7AE.evidence: not stated (the abstract is cut off before experiments; it targets compact vision-language models for dynamic spatial reasoning).

zCNHISpxH5.one_liner: Identifies which editable agent component caused a failure by contrasting failed runs with successful runs of the same tasks.
zCNHISpxH5.problem: When a multi-component LLM agent fails, the binary outcome does not say which component (prompts, tool descriptions, experience banks) to edit, so single-component optimizers miss defects and joint search wastes budget.
zCNHISpxH5.method: CATO contrasts failures with successful runs of the same tasks under a moderately different configuration, scores how strongly each component is implicated, and writes a textual gradient. It proposes more single-component edits for higher-scoring components and keeps the best configurations on a held-out validation set.
zCNHISpxH5.key_idea: Attribute failures to editable components by contrast with same-task successes, then spend edit proposals in proportion to each component's attribution score.
zCNHISpxH5.evidence: Controlled fault injection, plus AppWorld, WebArena and BBH with three backbones against six baselines.
zCNHISpxH5.claimed_gains: Identifies the faulty component in 95.7% of injected faults, 42.9 points more than trajectory-only diagnosis; edits repair 89.8% of failures while preserving 85.3% of solved tasks; outperforms all six baselines in every setting.

WxTDDTWgDh.one_liner: Replaces index-based RoPE angles with timestamp-based multiscale rotations, shifted queries and non-stationary keys for sequential recommendation.
WxTDDTWgDh.problem: In recommendation an interaction index records only event order, not elapsed time, behavioral cycles or calendar phase, so index-based RoPE misses temporal structure.
WxTDDTWgDh.method: T-RoPE uses timestamp-based rotation angles with learnable temporal coefficients, multiscale frequency banks, shifted query alignment and non-stationary key rotation. The authors prove that standard RoPE, even on timestamps, stays time-translation invariant and cannot separate seasonal contexts.
WxTDDTWgDh.key_idea: Rotate queries and keys by learnable multiscale functions of timestamps, which breaks the time-translation invariance of standard RoPE while keeping its interface.
WxTDDTWgDh.evidence: Five public benchmarks, an industrial e-commerce dataset with more than 6B interactions against an HSTU + Time RAB backbone, ablations, and an online A/B test (per the TL;DR).
WxTDDTWgDh.claimed_gains: Best on every metric on all five public datasets, with 78 to 130% higher HR@10 on PixelRec and 8 to 12% across metrics on Amazon Books; on the 6B-interaction dataset it improves every metric by 13 to 82% over HSTU + Time RAB.

sCvpzJ4vzb.one_liner: Corrects on-policy distillation from causal AR teachers to block diffusion students by accounting for the student's visible future context.
sCvpzJ4vzb.problem: In AR-to-block-diffusion distillation the student predicts from the whole partially denoised block including future context, while the causal AR teacher target uses only the prefix, so the teacher signal is misaligned.
sCvpzJ4vzb.method: d-OPD is a future-aware correction to on-policy distillation so that the teacher distribution reflects information available to the block-diffusion student; the abstract is cut off before describing the mechanism in detail.
sCvpzJ4vzb.key_idea: Correct the causal AR teacher target for the future context that the block-diffusion student sees at the same training state.
sCvpzJ4vzb.evidence: Per the TL;DR, accuracy and training efficiency are evaluated across model scales; datasets and settings are cut off in the abstract.

KtwqSdcu2v.one_liner: Scores candidate selectivity from a conditional diffusion model's denoising-error contrast under target and competitor conditions with shared noise.
KtwqSdcu2v.problem: Conditional generative models do not directly optimize preference for a target condition over alternatives, and evaluating every candidate across conditions is too costly for online optimization.
KtwqSdcu2v.method: SCORED contrasts the generator's denoising errors for the same candidate under target and competitor conditions using shared noise, as a reward that needs only forward passes. Mean-centered reward-weighted regression adds offline binding information, then multi-objective RL combines selectivity and molecular-quality rewards for OSDA generation.
KtwqSdcu2v.key_idea: Use the difference in a conditional diffusion model's denoising error between target and competitor conditions, under shared noise, as a selectivity reward.
KtwqSdcu2v.evidence: OSDA generation for zeolites, evaluated on six held-out frameworks under frozen-pose force-field evaluation across three runs, with matched ablations and a recent LLM-based generator as comparison.
KtwqSdcu2v.claimed_gains: Mean competition score of 5.03 +/- 0.33 kJ/mol Si over six held-out frameworks versus 9.72 for a recent LLM-based generator (lower is better); ablations score 6.34 without the competitor contrast and 6.50 without the denoising reward; a six-condition panel takes 7.86 ms versus 8.3 s for docking.

BhYm577QTB.one_liner: Prefetches input-specialized low-rank compensators from second-tier memory to recover accuracy of aggressively quantized on-device LLMs.
BhYm577QTB.problem: Aggressive post-training quantization degrades accuracy, correction data is capped by device memory, and transfer bandwidth from second-tier memory limits how much can be fetched per input.
BhYm577QTB.method: Input-partition-wise compensation stores specialized low-rank compensators per input region without increasing the data fetched per input. AquaPIC adds output-error-aligned clustering, shared block-level partitions and a lightweight residual-based estimator that selects and prefetches compensators while the preceding block executes.
BhYm577QTB.key_idea: Store many low-rank compensators for different input partitions in second-tier memory and prefetch the one an estimator selects while the previous block runs.
BhYm577QTB.evidence: Two LLMs and two quantization methods, measured on zero-shot accuracy and latency across discrete GPU and unified memory setups.
BhYm577QTB.claimed_gains: Improves 2-bit zero-shot accuracy by 6.8 percentage points on average over the strongest same-rank baselines, with 2.26% average latency overhead.

f8IUGy0sTC.one_liner: Predicts whole visual primitives (points, boxes, trajectories) in one forward pass with a lightweight drafter instead of token-by-token decoding.
f8IUGy0sTC.problem: Autoregressive VLMs generate visual plans one coordinate token at a time, which becomes costly for richer predictions such as long trajectories.
f8IUGy0sTC.method: VFlash uses a lightweight drafter whose layout adapts to primitive type, dimensionality and length to predict a primitive's coordinates jointly. It trains on annotated primitives and accepts structurally valid predictions without requiring target-token agreement.
f8IUGy0sTC.key_idea: Exploit the known structure of visual primitives to decode all coordinates jointly in one pass and accept valid outputs without matching the autoregressive token sequence.
f8IUGy0sTC.evidence: 2D and 3D robot trajectory tasks compared with autoregressive decoding, plus a world action model conditioned on VFlash plans evaluated on four MolmoSpaces task suites.
f8IUGy0sTC.claimed_gains: About 25x faster generation for 3D point motion forecasting in preliminary single-rollout measurements, and 70.2% average success across four MolmoSpaces task suites (the comparison is cut off).

WzAAxUKLPF.one_liner: Watermarks MoE LLM outputs by perturbing expert selection at each router, inside the inference loop.
WzAAxUKLPF.problem: Existing LLM watermarking degrades model performance on restricted, complicated tasks and adds inference overhead that blocks deployment in latency-critical systems.
WzAAxUKLPF.method: WaterMoE embeds signals through controlled perturbation of expert selection at each router, which accumulates into a token selection shift at the output. The authors also build a benchmark that evaluates 9 representative watermarking methods.
WzAAxUKLPF.key_idea: Perturb MoE router expert selection to embed watermark signals within the forward pass, instead of post-hoc token sampling.
WzAAxUKLPF.evidence: A benchmark across generation tasks evaluating 9 representative watermarking methods, followed by comparisons against existing methods.
WzAAxUKLPF.claimed_gains: not stated with numbers; the abstract reports fidelity close to the unwatermarked model with negligible quality degradation and computational overhead.

NdKGU4ZjVG.one_liner: Test-time RL with a learned critic recalibrated on a labeled reference set to sustain gains on unlabeled problems.
NdKGU4ZjVG.problem: Test-time training with agreement or confidence as proxy rewards gains early but can plateau or reverse with further training.
NdKGU4ZjVG.method: C-TTRL uses a learned critic to reward policy updates on unlabeled test problems; at each iteration, verified responses from the updated policy on a separate, non-overlapping labeled reference set are used solely to recalibrate the critic.
NdKGU4ZjVG.key_idea: Reward unlabeled-problem updates with a critic that is recalibrated every iteration on verified rollouts from a separate labeled reference set.
NdKGU4ZjVG.evidence: OLMo3 and Qwen3 models compared against self-rewarded baselines, with controlled comparisons of the roles of unlabeled test problems and critic recalibration.
NdKGU4ZjVG.claimed_gains: On AIME 2024, Avg@16 rises from 33.0% to 51.1% for OLMo3-7B and from 42.3% to 65.8% for Qwen3-14B.

j1GOA5D2cm.one_liner: Benchmark of 380 multi-reference audio-video generation tasks with a reference-aware pairwise evaluation protocol.
j1GOA5D2cm.problem: Audio-video generation from 2-10 heterogeneous multimodal references requires compositional control and grounded understanding of the multimodal context.
j1GOA5D2cm.method: ORAV Bench has 380 task instances with 9 semantic roles and 30 role compositions; its pairwise protocol prepares visual and auditory evidence, compares each reference's intended contribution, and checks the overall verdict in both presentation orders.
j1GOA5D2cm.key_idea: Judge open-ended outputs pairwise per reference role with prepared audio-visual evidence, and check the verdict in both presentation orders.
j1GOA5D2cm.evidence: Held-out agreement with human judgments and an evaluation of 5 frontier systems.
j1GOA5D2cm.claimed_gains: The protocol achieves 85.46% effective agreement with human judgments on held-out instances.

HOk367J7I0.one_liner: Trains LLM agents to take over harness control decisions via curriculum over teacher trajectories under progressively weaker harnesses.
HOk367J7I0.problem: Training on harness-supported trajectories improves task performance but leaves control decisions (what to investigate, whether to revise, when to stop) dependent on runtime intervention.
HOk367J7I0.method: Introduces Harness Annealing Training (HAT), which combines explicit control supervision with a curriculum over teacher trajectories collected under progressively weaker harnesses. The goal, called harness internalization, is to assume control responsibilities while retaining task performance after the support is withdrawn.
HOk367J7I0.key_idea: Curriculum over teacher trajectories gathered with progressively weaker harnesses, plus explicit control supervision, so the model learns to make the control decisions itself.
HOk367J7I0.evidence: Experiments with 9B and 35B models on SWE-QA and SWE-QA-Pro evaluate every checkpoint under four deployment harnesses.
HOk367J7I0.claimed_gains: not stated numerically; selected annealed checkpoints with tools alone score close to their starting checkpoints with the full harness, and benefits vary with model scale and deployment configuration.

AU4UTqaiko.one_liner: Probabilistic model infers skill boundaries and shared partial-order precedence constraints from agent action traces using semi-Markov dynamic programming.
AU4UTqaiko.problem: Agent traces are sequential, but the procedures they record may allow alternative action orders, repetition, and repair, which a single recorded sequence does not capture.
AU4UTqaiko.method: RPOS jointly infers skill boundaries, assignments, and shared precedence constraints from action-labelled traces; each skill instance tracks the validity of action outputs to model repetition and repair without adding cycles to its shared graph. Semi-Markov dynamic programming sums exactly over admissible segmentations and skill assignments to evaluate structural proposals.
AU4UTqaiko.key_idea: Skills are shared precedence graphs; per-instance output-validity tracking handles repetition and repair acyclically, and semi-Markov dynamic programming scores structure proposals exactly.
AU4UTqaiko.evidence: Synthetic data, coverage-controlled TaskBench simulations against total-order and sequence models, tau^3-Retail library learning, and 120 paired synthetic Retail tasks comparing an executor using the learned library with a stepwise agent.
AU4UTqaiko.claimed_gains: An executor combining the learned library reduces online token use by 86.97% relative to a stepwise agent while meeting a prespecified non-inferiority margin for strict task success.

8P4OvVlPj3.one_liner: Reinforcement learning dispatcher couples request allocation and assignment via optimal transport for dynamic multiple traveling salesman problem.
8P4OvVlPj3.problem: In dynamic mTSP (DmTSP), requests arrive sequentially and must be allocated across agents and assigned individually without knowledge of future demand, while accounting for downstream routing effects.
8P4OvVlPj3.method: OT-Dispatch Net uses an agent marginal and transport costs to model request allocation and agent-request preferences, so optimal transport couples them in one dispatch plan. A soft-quota decoder maps the transport plan to feasible joint assignments, and the policy is trained with a potential-based reward capturing downstream routing effects.
8P4OvVlPj3.key_idea: Optimal transport with an agent marginal and agent-request transport costs yields a joint dispatch plan, decoded into feasible assignments by a soft-quota decoder.
8P4OvVlPj3.evidence: A theoretical characterization of how approximation errors affect dispatch quality (workload stability under bounded decision error), plus experiments on synthetic and real-world replay settings.
8P4OvVlPj3.claimed_gains: not stated numerically; the abstract claims superior performance over existing learning-based methods, and the TLDR claims reduced waiting time and generally lower makespan.

sksqZDvupj.one_liner: Modular benchmark decomposing neural primal heuristics for MILP into Learner, Enforcer, and Refiner stages for controlled comparison.
sksqZDvupj.problem: Neural prediction, solver-backed completion, and incumbent refinement are entangled in monolithic ML4MILP pipelines, and datasets, training styles, solver backends, and evaluation protocols vary across studies, so progress is hard to compare.
sksqZDvupj.method: ML4MILP-Bench splits the pipeline into a Learner (bipartite graph to variable-wise soft scores), an Enforcer (predictions to a first complete solution), and a Refiner (improves a feasible incumbent under fixed budgets). It re-implements and recombines 8 learners, 6 enforcers, and 3 refiners with re-encapsulated solver backends.
sksqZDvupj.key_idea: Disentangle the pipeline into Learner, Enforcer, and Refiner modules so raw neural predictions and solver-backed components can be assessed separately and recombined.
sksqZDvupj.evidence: Experiments across diverse settings, primarily binary ILPs with extensions to mixed-integer settings, separately assess raw neural predictions and their interactions with solver-backed components.

Ce6CIpBqr1.one_liner: EviGaze benchmark tests whether multimodal LLMs ground social-gaze function judgments in post-gaze evidence intervals by removing them.
Ce6CIpBqr1.problem: MLLMs are evaluated on gaze following, but whether they ground functional judgments of a look in the subsequent interaction is largely unexplored.
Ce6CIpBqr1.method: EviGaze annotates 5,120 gaze events from four social-video corpora with their function and evidence interval. Removing the evidence interval withdraws the grounds for judgment while the look stays visible, and evidence-grounding failure (EGF) is label retention after removal once target and evidence are located.
Ce6CIpBqr1.key_idea: Remove the post-gaze evidence interval and measure whether the model's function label persists (EGF), exposing judgments that are not tied to the evidence.
Ce6CIpBqr1.evidence: Benchmarks fifteen MLLMs, probes model states in seven analyzed models, and tests prompting models to describe the evidence before answering against a matched placebo.
Ce6CIpBqr1.claimed_gains: Evidence removal lowers model accuracy by only 16.0 percentage points against 64.4 for humans, and EGF persists across all fifteen MLLMs.

GFFm8mrSRa.one_liner: Benchmark for non-contact human-object interaction in MLLMs, plus CLASP, which edits weights to suppress grounding errors by type.
GFFm8mrSRa.problem: Existing benchmarks evaluate gaze, pointing, and contextual cues separately, limiting systematic assessment of how MLLMs identify a person's target in non-contact human-object interactions.
GFFm8mrSRa.method: LongHOI-Bench has 6,240 images and 56,880 questions with human-verified targets and typed negatives tied to drift, distractor, and ambiguity errors. CLASP combines error-type diagnosis, contrast-based layer selection, and weighted suppression through analytic weight editing.
GFFm8mrSRa.key_idea: Diagnose the grounding error type, pick layers by contrasting grounded versus misgrounded cases, and suppress the corresponding directions via analytic weight editing.
GFFm8mrSRa.evidence: Benchmarks 13 proprietary and open-source MLLMs with a balanced error audit; CLASP is evaluated on paired localization queries with direction controls.
GFFm8mrSRa.claimed_gains: The strongest model reaches 68.5% mean accuracy while humans exceed 92% in each category; CLASP corrects 69.8% of distractor errors while introducing errors in 4.2% of initially correct predictions.

TRVP5LTMC9.one_liner: Environment for evaluating and training LLM agent teams where pivotal information is deliberately distributed across participants.
TRVP5LTMC9.problem: AI agents are mostly trained and benchmarked in isolation, although many real-world decisions require teams to integrate information distributed across participants.
TRVP5LTMC9.method: TeamGym builds team decision problems from legal, finance, medical, and software engineering corpora and identifies a minimal set of facts that are each necessary and jointly sufficient for a correct decision (pivotal information). This lets it control how those facts are distributed and track whether agents find and integrate them.
TRVP5LTMC9.key_idea: Identify a minimal necessary-and-sufficient fact set per decision, then control its distribution across agents to isolate communication and retrieval failures.
TRVP5LTMC9.evidence: Examines 8 language models on 12 source corpora; the TLDR also mentions reinforcement learning of team coordination (the abstract is truncated before the details).
TRVP5LTMC9.claimed_gains: Distributing pivotal information lowers success rate by 22.9 percentage points on average (communication gap), and by a further 19.9 points when participants must retrieve it themselves (retrieval gap).

hHrOwUVk9O.one_liner: Incrementally maintains Earley parse state and token masks under append-only runtime grammar updates, avoiding prefix replay.
hHrOwUVk9O.problem: When a first-seen runtime grammar update changes the parser state of an already committed prefix, existing engines reconstruct the constraint state and repeat parsing work over the prefix.
hHrOwUVk9O.method: GramDelta maintains parse state over the committed prefix and propagates only the changes induced by newly added grammar rules through historical dependencies. It then maps the updated parse state to exact next-token masks via compilation-free factorized projection over shared historical charts.
hHrOwUVk9O.key_idea: Propagate only rule-addition deltas through historical Earley chart dependencies and project to token masks over shared charts, avoiding prefix replay and mask-cache recompilation.
hHrOwUVk9O.evidence: Experiments across four model configurations compared with XGrammar (the abstract is truncated before the results).
hHrOwUVk9O.claimed_gains: Per the TLDR, median update handling is sped up by 1.33 to 1.69 times versus XGrammar across four model configurations (symbols garbled in the source).

gxUJiBISEh.one_liner: Online learning and unlearning for tree ensembles using structural, reconstruction, and split-change sparsity with configurable exactness.
gxUJiBISEh.problem: A single sample insertion or deletion in a tree ensemble can trigger costly whole-tree reconstruction, so cheap training and inference do not imply cheap maintenance.
gxUJiBISEh.method: Sparse Forest limits tree complexity (structural sparsity), repairs subtrees in place while reusing descendants (reconstruction sparsity), and keeps satisfactory splits under a controlled suboptimality tolerance (split-change sparsity). It formalizes (epsilon, phi)-suboptimality so exactness becomes a configurable property.
gxUJiBISEh.key_idea: In-place subtree repair with split retention under an (epsilon, phi)-suboptimality tolerance, so exactness is a tunable setting that trades against efficiency.
gxUJiBISEh.evidence: The visible (truncated) abstract gives no experiments; the TLDR says the method can be bit-identical to retraining or trade exactness for efficiency.

nIJijNgpHj.one_liner: Finds interpretable directions in LLM activations directly via non-Gaussianity (ICA) instead of training sparse autoencoders.
nIJijNgpHj.problem: Interpretable directions are usually found through indirect objectives such as sparse reconstruction, and it is unclear what statistical structure distinguishes them or whether it can be used directly.
nIJijNgpHj.method: Observes that projections of residual-stream activations along SAE decoder directions are far more non-Gaussian than along random directions, then introduces ICA Lens, a workflow for discovery, annotation, and evaluation of non-Gaussian directions in residual-stream activations without training another sparse dictionary.
nIJijNgpHj.key_idea: Search activation space for maximally non-Gaussian projection directions (independent component analysis) rather than learning a sparse dictionary.
nIJijNgpHj.evidence: Experiments on GPT-2 Small, Gemma-2-2B, and Qwen-3.5-9B Base, with recovered directions assessed under human annotation and a second annotation setting (truncated).

mhnZDC6dOE.one_liner: Replay allocation for continual learning aggregates loss changes with a kernel and redistributes replay mass via entropy-regularized transport.
mhnZDC6dOE.problem: Replay priorities based on individual loss increases overlook how related memories respond to the same update and can overemphasize isolated responses.
mhnZDC6dOE.method: SPHERE uses a representation kernel to aggregate signed prospective loss changes, attenuating unsupported spikes while retaining coherent increases, then formulates allocation as entropy-regularized transport that penalizes long-distance transfers. Replay coefficients derived from the transport objective's sensitivity are blended with uniform replay.
mhnZDC6dOE.key_idea: Kernel-smooth prospective loss changes over nearby memories to suppress isolated spikes, then allocate replay mass by entropy-regularized transport penalizing long-distance transfers.
mhnZDC6dOE.evidence: Analysis gives conditions under which kernel aggregation improves risk estimation and bounds transport-value inflation; experiments cover noisy-label vision tasks, continual language-model instruction tuning, and code-generation reinforcement learning with incomplete test rewards.
mhnZDC6dOE.claimed_gains: not stated numerically; the abstract says SPHERE improves accuracy and reduces forgetting across the listed settings.

bP5QEJCDX4.one_liner: Adapts 3D foundation models with an unposed top-down render and view-type decoupling for multi-room geometry and pose estimation.
bP5QEJCDX4.problem: Feed-forward 3D foundation models fail in multi-room environments where opaque walls remove visual overlap and spatial continuity between cameras in different rooms.
bP5QEJCDX4.method: HOME^3 takes an unposed top-down RGB render alongside perspective captures, and the authors build the TD-HOMES dataset suite (real-world scans, designer-crafted spaces, agentic procedural environments). A view-type decoupling design separates projection weights and feed-forward networks in global cross-frame attention between top-down and perspective views.
bP5QEJCDX4.key_idea: Decouple projection weights and feed-forward networks in global cross-frame attention by view type (top-down versus perspective) to avoid representational interference while using top-down context.
bP5QEJCDX4.evidence: Experiments on multi-room non-overlapping views and on standard overlapping scenes; datasets and metrics are not named in the abstract.

T3QNqS7sJH.one_liner: End-to-end streaming VideoLLM for always-on real-time question answering and proactive responses on live video streams.
T3QNqS7sJH.problem: Most VideoLLMs are offline, and streaming ones rely on decoupled trigger-response pipelines or captioning-style narration, which limits open-ended question answering and long-horizon interaction.
T3QNqS7sJH.method: AURA is a unified VideoLLM framework that continuously processes video streams, integrating context management, data construction, training objectives, and deployment optimization. It supports a real-time demo system with ASR and TTS.
T3QNqS7sJH.key_idea: A single end-to-end VideoLLM handles both real-time question answering and proactive responses over a stream, with context management and training objectives designed for long-horizon streaming.
T3QNqS7sJH.evidence: Streaming benchmarks (not named in the abstract) and a real-time demo system with ASR and TTS.
T3QNqS7sJH.claimed_gains: The abstract claims leading performance on streaming benchmarks without giving scores, and the demo system runs at 2 FPS on two 80 GB GPUs.

pEQRVgGrr9.one_liner: Closed-form box-shift formula at the IoU threshold explains AP fragility and yields size-adaptive thresholds.
pEQRVgGrr9.problem: AP is discontinuous in box coordinates, and where the discontinuity falls and why a single-pixel shift can drop mAP by double digits (hitting small objects hardest) has lacked an explanation.
pEQRVgGrr9.method: Derives closed-form IoU expressions under translation and corner-anchored scaling, giving the exact shift t*(tau, W) = W(1-tau)/(1+tau) at which a detection flips from correct to incorrect, a zero-parameter formula in object size W and IoU threshold tau. Inverting the formula yields a size-adaptive threshold.
pEQRVgGrr9.key_idea: One flip-shift formula is the shared mechanism behind small-object fragility, stronger diagonal-shift sensitivity, near-symmetric enlarge and shrink effects, and faster mAP than AP50 degradation.
pEQRVgGrr9.evidence: Validated against official COCOeval on real COCO annotations, transferred to LVIS without refitting, and compared with the relative degradation shape of Faster R-CNN and YOLOv11.
pEQRVgGrr9.claimed_gains: MAE <= 0.032 and correlation >= 0.997 against COCOeval, and the size-adaptive threshold cuts the size bias of AP degradation roughly twentyfold (the rest of the sentence is truncated).

NlRFbIkVRG.one_liner: Budgeted two-path contrastive framework mines diverse same-class positives using LLM same-or-different judgments for generalized category discovery.
NlRFbIkVRG.problem: LLM-assisted GCD methods improve the reliability of training signals but under-emphasize positive diversity, and expanding the candidate pool without ground-truth labels introduces false-positive relations.
NlRFbIkVRG.method: DiPo, for a fraction of anchors, expands the candidate pool and keeps positives that LLM same-or-different judgments mark as semantically valid but less similar. For the remaining anchors it uses the nearest cluster-consistent mutual neighbor as a reliable local positive.
NlRFbIkVRG.key_idea: Spend a limited LLM verification budget on anchors with expanded, less-similar candidates, while other anchors use a cluster-consistent mutual nearest neighbor as positive.
NlRFbIkVRG.evidence: An oracle study with ground-truth filtering shows that restricting positives to highly similar candidates limits discovery; extensive experiments compare against LLM-assisted baselines (details truncated).
NlRFbIkVRG.claimed_gains: Best average performance among strong LLM-assisted baselines and particularly effective on novel classes; no numbers stated.

vLvdOZeMyR.one_liner: Low-cost, fully fabricable bimanual robot platform on dual SO-101 arms with standardized assets, data, and calibration for cross-instance transfer.
vLvdOZeMyR.problem: Real-world robot data are fragmented across embodiments and platform realizations, and even nominally identical hardware yields different observation and action distributions, which makes aggregation and reuse hard.
vLvdOZeMyR.method: BREE standardizes embodiment, sensing, workspace, and calibration. BREE-Assets provides fabricable objects, fixtures, and a physical calibrator for cross-instance alignment, and BREE-Data provides eight standardized bimanual tasks with demonstrations and evaluation protocols.
vLvdOZeMyR.key_idea: Standardize hardware, workspace, and a physical calibrator so data collected on different platform instances share one observation and action distribution.
vLvdOZeMyR.evidence: Cross-instance evaluations show that policies trained on one BREE instance transfer directly to another and that aggregating data from multiple instances improves policy performance.
vLvdOZeMyR.claimed_gains: The platform costs about $600; transfer and multi-instance scaling are reported qualitatively without numbers.

Mj329S1TCg.one_liner: Detects stagnant neurons with small gradient-based updates in MARL and repairs them with neuron-local, function-preserving capacity reallocation.
Mj329S1TCg.problem: MARL methods lose plasticity under sequential task changes, and existing interventions do not directly identify and repair stagnant neurons, which show disproportionately small update activity relative to parameter scale and layer peers.
Mj329S1TCg.method: KNIFE identifies impaired units with a diagnosis step (RUA), restores trainable capacity by local surgery that exactly preserves the network function at the intervention boundary, and recycles temporary capacity by decay with pruning.
Mj329S1TCg.key_idea: Diagnose stagnant neurons by their relative gradient-update activity, then locally re-inject trainable capacity in a function-preserving way and later prune it.
Mj329S1TCg.evidence: SMACv2, SMAC, Predator-Prey, matrix games, and MEAL, plus MAPPO, MADDPG, DGN, and single-agent PPO.
Mj329S1TCg.claimed_gains: not stated numerically; the abstract says KNIFE consistently outperforms the compared plasticity interventions.

NkJsmwoD38.one_liner: Region-level defect-aware reward model plus spatial credit assignment onto latent tokens for RL-trained visual text generation.
NkJsmwoD38.problem: Recognition-based rewards overlook visible glyph defects, and whole-image scalar feedback hides the uneven quality of individual text regions, leaving wrong wording and malformed glyphs.
NkJsmwoD38.method: TextDART localizes individual text regions and scores their semantic correctness and glyph quality independently. SCANNER normalizes rewards for each text target across sampled images and casts the resulting regional advantages onto the corresponding latent tokens.
NkJsmwoD38.key_idea: Compute per-text-region advantages from a defect-aware reward and assign them to that region's latent tokens, instead of one scalar for the whole image.
NkJsmwoD38.evidence: Experiments on existing benchmarks and the newly built PolyText-Bench.
NkJsmwoD38.claimed_gains: The abstract claims the best text accuracy and glyph fidelity on the benchmarks; no numbers stated.

cWQOoP3ZJp.one_liner: Localizes consequential errors in failed agent trajectories with an LLM and trains on rubric-scored local rollouts from restored states.
cWQOoP3ZJp.problem: GRPO assigns the same trajectory-level advantage to all actions in long-horizon agent training, which mismatches ideal action-specific credit because of value shifts inherited from history and downstream stochasticity.
cWQOoP3ZJp.method: An LLM-based locator identifies consequential errors in failed trajectories and writes repair rubrics. The interaction state is restored before each error, bounded local continuations are sampled and scored against the rubrics, and these local groups are combined with outcome-scored full-trajectory groups for policy optimization.
cWQOoP3ZJp.key_idea: Restore state before located errors, sample short continuations scored by repair rubrics, and mix them with trajectory-level groups to give targeted credit.
cWQOoP3ZJp.evidence: A policy-gradient analysis of the advantage mismatch, an empirical finding that sharp value changes concentrate in a small fraction of actions, and experiments comparing against GRPO and related methods under the same rollout budget (details truncated).
cWQOoP3ZJp.claimed_gains: Outperforms GRPO and most related methods under the same rollout budget; no numbers visible in the truncated abstract.

5kBkgGHrpU.one_liner: Augments each coarse liquid particle with learnable anisotropic ellipsoidal components and predicts residual corrections toward a high-resolution teacher.
5kBkgGHrpU.problem: Recovering fine-scale dynamics from coarse particle liquid simulations typically relies on generating extra particles, which adds computational overhead and gives a poor representation.
5kBkgGHrpU.method: AnisoLift is a structured latent closure that gives each coarse particle anisotropic ellipsoidal components capturing directional local structure. The model predicts residual corrections to particle states toward the aligned high-resolution teacher, trained to jointly supervise particle dynamics and anisotropic geometry.
5kBkgGHrpU.key_idea: Per-particle learnable anisotropic ellipsoids encode directional local flow structure without extra particles, and residual state corrections move the particles toward the teacher.
5kBkgGHrpU.evidence: Experiments on coarse liquid simulations compared against fully resolved flow behavior; datasets and metrics are not named in the abstract.

5fD1EyOO6Q.one_liner: Modulates queries, keys, and values of test-time-training equivalent linear attention with semantic task-progress signals in VLA models.
5fD1EyOO6Q.problem: Conventional KV-binding test-time-training updates leave implicit how each interaction's semantics should guide its contribution to context in Vision-Language-Action models.
5fD1EyOO6Q.method: SELA-TTT modulates the queries, keys, and values in TTT's equivalent time-evolving linear-attention formulation using explicit semantic signals (subtask advancement, overall goal progress, atomic-skill optimality), conditioning both context writes and reads.
5fD1EyOO6Q.key_idea: Inject semantic progress signals into the equivalent linear-attention form of TTT's fast-weight update, gating what is written to and read from the fast state.
5fD1EyOO6Q.evidence: Simulation benchmarks and real-world task suites, a comparison of modulation placement (equivalent linear attention versus input features or raw TTT projections), and controlled label perturbations.
5fD1EyOO6Q.claimed_gains: Improved success over TTT baselines; no numbers stated.

xkVuywbGkJ.one_liner: Skeleton-agnostic motion generation using root and kinematic chain-segment tokens with a rig-conditioned decoder producing local joint rotations.
xkVuywbGkJ.problem: Motion representations are tightly coupled to skeletal structure: position-based ones are sensitive to rig discretization and need ambiguous inverse kinematics, while local rotations entangle generation with rig-specific kinematics.
xkVuywbGkJ.method: ChainMo represents motion as a root token plus a variable set of disjoint, non-branching kinematic chain-segment tokens. A target-rig-conditioned decoder realizes the abstract motion as local joint rotations without external inverse kinematics, and generation uses a flow-matching model (rest truncated).
xkVuywbGkJ.key_idea: Separate a shared chain-segment motion abstraction from target-rig-specific rotation realization, making motion robust to variation in within-chain joint count.
xkVuywbGkJ.evidence: not stated in the visible (truncated) abstract

Ap9MIqvsmJ.one_liner: Parameter-efficient MoE adaptation that modulates learned subspaces within selected experts conditioned on routing signals, keeping pretrained routing.
Ap9MIqvsmJ.problem: Sparse MoE routing scores weight each selected expert equally across all representation dimensions, and the adaptation potential and risks of changing this aggregation are unclear.
Ap9MIqvsmJ.method: RC-GEM keeps pretrained expert selection and aggregation weights and uses routing signals to condition subspace-wise modulation within each selected expert. It is motivated by two OLMoE diagnostics: an oracle redistribution of expert weights and a learned residual aggregation controller.
Ap9MIqvsmJ.key_idea: Condition fine-grained, subspace-wise modulation inside each selected expert on routing signals while leaving pretrained expert selection and weights unchanged.
Ap9MIqvsmJ.evidence: Diagnostics on OLMoE, then adaptation experiments on OLMoE and Qwen1.5-MoE against MoE adaptation methods and conventional PEFT baselines.
Ap9MIqvsmJ.claimed_gains: An oracle redistribution of expert weights (mean conditional KL about 0.01) improves the seven-benchmark average by 3.3 points, and RC-GEM approaches or surpasses full fine-tuning in average ID performance with fewer than 0.1% trainable parameters.

K5G2K8prPU.one_liner: Risk criterion for when sharing environment randomness across rollouts helps group-based RL, based on gradient estimation risk.
K5G2K8prPU.problem: Sharing environmental randomness reduces comparison noise in group-based RL but cuts independent environment coverage under a fixed rollout budget, and reward statistics alone cannot tell when sharing helps.
K5G2K8prPU.method: ESRA (Environment-Sharing Risk Analysis) derives an exact finite-group risk criterion for raw leave-one-out gradients at a frozen policy, trading within-environment fluctuations against differences in mean gradients across environments. It is tested with independent gradient audits and controlled sharing interventions.
K5G2K8prPU.key_idea: Judge environment sharing by its effect on gradient estimation risk, balancing within-environment fluctuation against between-environment mean-gradient differences, rather than by reward variance.
K5G2K8prPU.evidence: Counterexamples with identical reward distributions but opposite sharing effects, and experiments with Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base on HotpotQA and ALFWorld.
K5G2K8prPU.claimed_gains: At matched total training cost, environment sharing alone improves native GRPO by 7.10 percentage points on average, and shared collection improves the two-task mean by 7.00 points over independent collection.

RzS0d7tlJP.one_liner: Generates phoneme-conditioned spike counts with a birth-death bridge and adaptive dispersion to cut cross-day speech-decoder calibration data.
RzS0d7tlJP.problem: Intracortical speech decoders degrade across recording days, requiring repeated collection of labeled target-day trials for recalibration.
RzS0d7tlJP.method: BURST is a generator-first count bridge whose state-dependent birth-death jump rates define the conditional path and control dispersion, trained by simulation-free bridge matching with analytic reverse-rate targets. A historical Fano-rate profile sets the base schedule, a few-shot day code adapts cross-channel tuning and a bounded profile displacement, and an alignment-free phoneme conditioner handles variable-length sequences.
RzS0d7tlJP.key_idea: A birth-death count bridge with state-dependent jump rates produces under-dispersed (sub-Poisson) spike counts whose Fano-rate profile adapts per recording day.
RzS0d7tlJP.evidence: Two transfer horizons on an intracortical speech dataset; the abstract also says generated counts reproduce the empirical high-rate sub-Poisson variability (truncated).
RzS0d7tlJP.claimed_gains: Equal mixtures of real and generated sentences consistently outperform real-only calibration at the same recording budget and approach calibration with twice as many real sentences; no other numbers stated.

SkOgWzmxMC.one_liner: Modality-wise on-policy distillation for joint audio-video generation using privileged cleaner video context, multi-noise sampling, and timestep weighting.
