ZwOoQcLotV.claimed_gains: With GPT-5.4, the OS-native agent completes 78.4% of DynamicWorld tasks across three runs versus 47.0% for MobileClaw while reducing the reported model-usage metric by 51.1%.

8qOKRk4Hvt.one_liner: Explains LLM post-training quantization robustness via cross-layer quantization-error cancellation and top-token output probability stability.
8qOKRk4Hvt.problem: Small per-layer weight rounding errors alone fail to explain why post-training quantization preserves accuracy in pretrained LLMs while severely degrading identically quantized random networks.
8qOKRk4Hvt.method: The authors compare hidden-state error propagation between randomly initialized and pretrained LLMs quantized to identical low-bit formats such as NVFP4. They quantify cross-layer directional opposition between newly injected and incoming propagated errors, along with output-layer probability sensitivity for high-ranked tokens.
8qOKRk4Hvt.key_idea: Pretrained weights induce partial cancellation between newly injected layer quantization errors and propagated upstream errors, while top-ranked token probabilities resist residual hidden-state perturbations.
8qOKRk4Hvt.evidence: Empirical comparisons of pretrained versus randomly initialized models across multiple LLM families and low-bit quantization formats including NVFP4.

q5jGL67AfU.one_liner: Completes missing chemical reaction byproducts via conservation-constrained conditional generation of electron redistribution matrices.
q5jGL67AfU.problem: Recorded organic reactions frequently omit byproducts, while existing completion heuristics and exact-match evaluations fail to enforce chemical conservation or assess unlabeled reaction corpora.
q5jGL67AfU.method: RxnComp models missing reaction species by conditionally generating electron redistribution matrices under explicit atom- and electron-conservation constraints. The authors also introduce a reference-free evaluation suite using chemical validity and quality proxy metrics when ground-truth byproducts are unavailable.
q5jGL67AfU.key_idea: Infer missing reaction byproducts by generating electron redistribution matrices subject to explicit chemical conservation constraints.
q5jGL67AfU.evidence: Evaluated across chemical reaction completion benchmark datasets using both reference-based and proposed reference-free proxy metrics.

9siJYeL7m7.one_liner: Benchmarks synergistic visual-tool and web-search use in multimodal agents using 418 tasks with over 2,000 stepwise process checkpoints.
9siJYeL7m7.problem: Existing multimodal benchmarks evaluate visual tool use and web search in isolation and check only final answers, overlooking whether tools were invoked accurately and efficiently.
9siJYeL7m7.method: Agentic-MME provides 418 real-world tasks across six domains and three difficulty tiers requiring combined visual manipulation and open-web search, annotated with over 2,000 stepwise verification checkpoints. It pairs these tasks with a unified evaluation harness supporting sandboxed code execution and process-level verification.
9siJYeL7m7.key_idea: Verify multimodal agents at over 2,000 intermediate process checkpoints on tasks requiring joint visual-tool manipulation and web-based knowledge search.
9siJYeL7m7.evidence: Constructs 418 manually annotated tasks averaging over 10 person-hours each across 6 domains and 3 difficulty levels with sandboxed code execution; model benchmark results are truncated in the abstract.

gKPWFS2o2l.one_liner: Maps sequence-model depth to Lie-algebra extensions and proves doubly exponential approximation-error decay with depth beyond expressivity limits.
gKPWFS2o2l.problem: Existing expressivity impossibility results for constant-depth parallelizable sequence models do not explain why deeper Transformers and state-space models approximate out-of-regime tasks accurately in practice.
gKPWFS2o2l.method: Using Lie-algebraic control theory, the authors establish a correspondence between layers of parallelizable sequence models and towers of Lie algebra extensions. From this characterization, they derive analytical approximation-error bounds as a function of model depth for tasks outside the constant-depth expressivity class.
gKPWFS2o2l.key_idea: Equate adding sequence-model layers to iterated Lie-algebra extensions, yielding a doubly exponential decay in state-tracking approximation error with depth.
gKPWFS2o2l.evidence: Analytical expressivity and approximation-error proofs validated empirically on symbolic word problems and continuous-valued state-tracking tasks.

KfvDCwyEFA.one_liner: Continuously evaluates single-cell foundation models on newly released, provenance-screened datasets across sequencing platforms and novel cell populations.
KfvDCwyEFA.problem: Static benchmarks for single-cell foundation models suffer from pretraining data contamination and fail to capture shifting sequencing technologies and newly discovered cell types.
KfvDCwyEFA.method: scLiveEval ingests newly released single-cell datasets over time while screening for training-data exposure via temporal and provenance records. It evaluates models on study-defined novel cell populations, compares relative rankings across sequencing-platform cohorts, and audits recurrent human-model label disagreements.
KfvDCwyEFA.key_idea: Continuously update single-cell foundation model benchmarks with provenance-screened post-cutoff datasets stratified by novel cell populations, sequencing platforms, and cross-model label disagreements.
KfvDCwyEFA.evidence: Empirical evaluation of single-cell foundation models across newly released multi-platform cohorts measuring novel-population detection, biological preservation, batch integration, and annotation disagreement.

VnPdHU5795.one_liner: Learns temporal-difference prefix rewards from sparse track preferences to guide passage-level reinforcement learning for music generation.
VnPdHU5795.problem: Coarse track-level outcome rewards fail to provide localized temporal credit for dynamic musical structure during post-training policy optimization.
VnPdHU5795.method: MusicGo trains a process reward model via temporal-difference learning to estimate the probability that a partial musical prefix yields a high-quality track from sparse outcome preferences, supported by the MusPR dataset. For policy optimization, PassGRPO applies these dense frame-level rewards to update music generators at passage granularity.
VnPdHU5795.key_idea: Bootstrap dense prefix-level musical process rewards from sparse track-level preferences via temporal-difference learning and optimize policies at passage granularity.
VnPdHU5795.evidence: Validated on the newly constructed MusPR dataset and in offline and online reinforcement learning settings for music generation.

EZiHUXzMtY.one_liner: COOPERTRACE fuses local LiDAR-camera features, attends across connected agents, and trains forecasting on deployment-matched tracker histories.
EZiHUXzMtY.problem: Cooperative motion prediction must combine multimodal sensing with end-to-end learning while handling realistic tracking histories and noise.
EZiHUXzMtY.method: COOPERTRACE fuses LiDAR and camera inputs at each agent and attends to connected agents' features through V2X communication. Its forecaster trains on previous-frame tracking outputs so explicit histories match those produced by its tracker at deployment.
EZiHUXzMtY.key_idea: Train cooperative forecasting on explicit histories generated by the model's own tracker while fusing local sensors and cross-agent features.
EZiHUXzMtY.evidence: A unified protocol makes every method forecast from its own tracker, with the abstract reporting simulated and real-world cooperative evaluations without naming datasets.

PWQduIpR01.one_liner: Speculative Pipeline Decoding overlaps next-token drafting from multi-depth features with parallel progress through target-model pipeline stages.
PWQduIpR01.problem: Multi-token speculative prediction compounds drafting difficulty and exposes draft latency during low-concurrency language-model inference.
PWQduIpR01.method: SPD divides the target model into pipeline stages so several tokens from one sequence advance concurrently. A Pipeline Draft Module combines multi-depth target features to predict the next token during each pipeline step, keeping the pipeline occupied while hiding draft latency.
PWQduIpR01.key_idea: Overlap feature-based next-token drafting with target-model pipeline steps that advance multiple sequence tokens in parallel.
PWQduIpR01.evidence: Experiments compare theoretical and wall-clock speedups against EAGLE-3 across pipeline widths, reporting better results at moderate widths.

n5hOF75CR0.one_liner: SimGarment backpropagates geometry and silhouette losses through garment simulation to train feed-forward sewing-pattern reconstruction from single images.
n5hOF75CR0.problem: Garment reconstruction training depends on sewing-panel annotations that are unavailable for many real scans and images.
n5hOF75CR0.method: A Transformer predicts sewing panels and stitching, assembles a mesh, and drapes it onto a parametric body through differentiable simulation. Chamfer and silhouette losses propagate through simulation, enabling training on mixed synthetic data, real scans, and in-the-wild RGB images.
n5hOF75CR0.key_idea: Differentiate through garment assembly and draping so geometric and silhouette supervision can train sewing-pattern predictions without universal panel annotations.
n5hOF75CR0.evidence: Zero-shot comparisons with feed-forward and optimization-based methods test generalization to garment categories absent from synthetic training data.
n5hOF75CR0.claimed_gains: SimGarment matches optimization-based reconstruction quality while running nearly five orders of magnitude faster, in under 0.1 seconds per image.

GAaKiNHi5i.one_liner: ReaLVR contrasts answers and visual evidence to supervise evidence preservation along free-running latent reasoning trajectories.
GAaKiNHi5i.problem: Final-answer rewards give insufficient guidance about which visual evidence latent reasoning tokens should preserve and where credit should land.
GAaKiNHi5i.method: ReaLVR supervises the model's own free-running latent trajectories by contrasting correct answers with model-generated wrong answers to locate stronger supervision. Contrasts between relevant and mismatched visual evidence specify what latent tokens should preserve.
GAaKiNHi5i.key_idea: Combine answer contrasts for supervision placement with visual-evidence contrasts for content preservation along latent trajectories.
GAaKiNHi5i.evidence: Latent-token perturbation analysis and evaluations across three model families compare ReaLVR with latent visual reasoning baselines, including five tasks on Qwen2.5-VL-7B.
GAaKiNHi5i.claimed_gains: ReaLVR achieves the highest five-task average of 63.7% on Qwen2.5-VL-7B among the evaluated latent visual reasoning baselines.

j05AfbtPYU.one_liner: CRBC merges rollout groups into an empirical process and solves its Bellman fixed point for critic-free step-level credit.
j05AfbtPYU.problem: Existing cross-rollout credit estimators fail to combine recursive evidence propagation with frequency-respecting aggregation of alternative continuations.
j05AfbtPYU.method: CRBC merges each rollout group into a finite empirical process with absorbing success and failure boundaries and solves its behavior-policy Bellman fixed point linearly. Empirical action and transition frequencies propagate evidence through shared anchors, then observed transitions back up state values into action values.
j05AfbtPYU.key_idea: Solve an empirical Bellman system over shared rollout anchors using observed action and transition frequencies to propagate step-level credit.

Tnx0zK2TPZ.one_liner: A gradient-boosted predictor ranks anchor decisions for selective release before a mixed-integer solver reoptimizes the resulting free variables.
Tnx0zK2TPZ.problem: Mixed-integer reoptimization needs to select which anchored decisions to release while balancing solution quality against solver freedom.
Tnx0zK2TPZ.method: A gradient-boosted tree ranks variables from structural, root-LP, and anchor-conditioned features, and a cumulative-score rule chooses an instance-specific free set. A MIP solver jointly optimizes released integer variables and continuous decisions, supported by a correction-coverage analysis.
Tnx0zK2TPZ.key_idea: Rank anchored integer decisions by learned correction signals and select their release budget through cumulative scores before joint solver reoptimization.
Tnx0zK2TPZ.evidence: A correction-coverage bound and experiments across three MIP families include MILPBench transfer from 20,000-40,000-variable training instances to problems with up to two million variables.
Tnx0zK2TPZ.claimed_gains: The method reduces mean optimality gaps by 14%-94% relative to matched-budget unrestricted solving and achieves competitive MILPBench objectives in 175--397 seconds of measured online runtime.

mF0AHoZ4Bt.one_liner: Compo conditions a pretrained image editor on spatial semantic, identity, text, and pixel bindings for controllable poster generation.
mF0AHoZ4Bt.problem: Text prompts force users to express two-dimensional poster composition through a one-dimensional word sequence.
mF0AHoZ4Bt.method: A Spatial Canvas Interface combines semantic, identity, text, and pixel bindings with element-level and global text specifications. Compo adapts a pretrained image editing model using automatically constructed supervision and accepts either user-built canvases or canvases planned from high-level requests.
mF0AHoZ4Bt.key_idea: Represent poster intent as spatial bindings and text specifications, then condition an adapted image editor on that structured canvas.
mF0AHoZ4Bt.evidence: A benchmark evaluates individual binding adherence and joint composition against general-purpose image generators and dedicated poster systems while assessing visual quality.

Pbm5sKnuHV.one_liner: ZeroStep trains a trajectory-supervised VAE encoder adapter to extract diffusion watermarks directly from generated images.
Pbm5sKnuHV.problem: Watermark verification typically requires costly diffusion inversion to recover initial watermarked noise.
Pbm5sKnuHV.method: ZeroStep trains a lightweight LoRA adapter on the VAE encoder using supervision across trajectory timesteps and latent components. Paired clean and distorted views train robust direct watermark extraction without denoiser evaluations.
Pbm5sKnuHV.key_idea: Train a VAE encoder adapter with watermark supervision across generation trajectories to read watermarks directly from endpoint images.
Pbm5sKnuHV.evidence: Trajectory analysis and experiments across diffusion and flow-matching backbones compare direct verification against inversion-based methods, including SD v3.5.
Pbm5sKnuHV.claimed_gains: On SD v3.5, ZeroStep raises watermark bit accuracy from 95.88% to 99.11% while reducing deployed model size from 2.5B to 35.01M parameters.

T4xO2YM0RB.one_liner: Gaze-RL redistributes rollout advantage using internal cross-modal geometry and uncertainty to weight visually grounded, decision-bearing response positions.
T4xO2YM0RB.problem: Trajectory-level multimodal rewards do not reflect the sparse, uneven positions where responses use visual evidence.
T4xO2YM0RB.method: Gaze-RL computes a latent reward landing field from cross-modal representations and local predictive uncertainty. Mean-one weights redistribute completion-level advantage toward visually anchored, decision-bearing tokens while preserving each rollout's total credit without auxiliary modules or process labels.
T4xO2YM0RB.key_idea: Normalize token weights from cross-modal geometry and predictive uncertainty to redistribute rollout advantage while preserving total credit.
T4xO2YM0RB.evidence: Training on a mixed image-video RL dataset improves Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3.5 in image and video evaluations, whose details are truncated in the supplied abstract.

kUANBMmbKQ.one_liner: Dandelion estimates streaming video depth with chunked inference, trained geometric anchors, and compressed distant history attention.
kUANBMmbKQ.problem: Generative video depth estimation is costly, and frame-wise streaming sacrifices temporal context while repeating per-frame inference.
kUANBMmbKQ.method: Dandelion selects a streaming chunk length to balance depth accuracy and latency, then trains geometric anchors from ground-truth depth history before extending stability through autoregressive rollout. Multi-scale History Attention compresses distant depth context to accelerate inference.
kUANBMmbKQ.key_idea: Combine chunked streaming with history-derived geometric anchors and multiscale compression of distant temporal context.
kUANBMmbKQ.evidence: The abstract describes analysis of streaming strategies and reports zero-shot depth performance, but truncates evaluation details.
kUANBMmbKQ.claimed_gains: Dandelion uses only 0.2% of the depth supervision used by VDA.

SXHU6x7cQl.one_liner: Retrieved cross-task visual experience guides adaptive screenshot-token selection for GUI agents.
SXHU6x7cQl.problem: GUI agents repeatedly process expensive screenshots while existing efficiency methods overlook reusable visual experience across completed tasks.
SXHU6x7cQl.method: PAVE retrieves relevant historical interactions and supplies them as a prior to a lightweight controller. The controller adaptively selects visual tokens from the current screen while retaining the underlying action model.
SXHU6x7cQl.key_idea: Use retrieved experience from completed tasks as a prior for selecting visual tokens in the current screenshot.
SXHU6x7cQl.evidence: Experiments evaluate offline GUI benchmarks and online in-the-wild environments while measuring visual-token computation and task performance.
SXHU6x7cQl.claimed_gains: PAVE reduces visual-token computation by up to 17.37% and 8.3% in offline and online evaluations while retaining original task performance.

fNfzxuMns4.one_liner: A preceding sentence's semantic hash defines a Hamming neighborhood of acceptable watermark continuations.
fNfzxuMns4.problem: Watermark-specific semantic preferences can exclude natural continuations, increasing sampling cost and narrowing generated meaning.
fNfzxuMns4.method: HammingMark centers watermark acceptance on the preceding sentence's semantic hash and accepts candidate hashes within its Hamming neighborhood. A coarse many-to-one hash map permits multiple semantic realizations within the valid region.
fNfzxuMns4.key_idea: Accept sentence candidates whose semantic hashes lie within a Hamming neighborhood centered on the preceding sentence's hash.
fNfzxuMns4.evidence: Experiments on C4 and BookSum assess robustness, detectability, generation quality, and sampling cost.
fNfzxuMns4.claimed_gains: HammingMark requires 2.2 sampled candidates per accepted sentence, a 72.8% reduction versus the most sampling-efficient existing method.

ZuNamQK6PF.one_liner: Feature-evolution manifolds constrain quantized representations in direction and magnitude.
ZuNamQK6PF.problem: Sensitivity-weighted reconstruction alone fails to prevent feature distortion and robustness loss during vision-transformer quantization.
ZuNamQK6PF.method: FLOW-Q uses evolution-aware learning to capture feature evolution in a manifold with global topological structure. A geometric constraint rectification module uses that manifold to correct quantized feature direction and magnitude.
ZuNamQK6PF.key_idea: Construct a manifold from feature evolution and use its geometry to rectify quantized feature directions and magnitudes.
ZuNamQK6PF.evidence: Experiments cover nine tasks across twelve benchmarks using DINOv3, conventional vision transformers, and mobile-efficient models.

GMbvkyJBaz.one_liner: Stateful visual workflows evaluate agent grounding, sensemaking, and artifact realization across repeated trials.
GMbvkyJBaz.problem: Existing work-agent evaluations leave unclear whether visual information supports reliable completion of entire practical workflows.
GMbvkyJBaz.method: Agentic-WorkBench provides controlled, stateful tasks across eleven work domains, with some observations available only during execution. It evaluates visual grounding, sensemaking, and realization through graded completion and repeated-trial success.
GMbvkyJBaz.key_idea: Evaluate complete stateful workflows with execution-dependent visual evidence and repeated trials to distinguish partial progress from repeatable completion.
GMbvkyJBaz.evidence: The benchmark evaluates nine model configurations on 115 tasks across eleven work domains.
GMbvkyJBaz.claimed_gains: The strongest configuration achieves 64.0% graded completion, solves 41.7% of tasks within three trials, and succeeds in all three on 22.6%.

OaK72WNzTO.one_liner: Elapsed-time encoding and supervised compressed memory turn window-level biosignal features into streaming long-context predictions.
OaK72WNzTO.problem: Short-window biosignal pipelines cannot adequately process hours-long, irregular, interrupted recordings.
OaK72WNzTO.method: BioLT feeds inter-window elapsed time explicitly into a streaming decoder and maintains a fixed-size compressed memory bank supervised by cumulative summary statistics. It accepts domain features or foundation-model embeddings with training and inference linear in recording length.
OaK72WNzTO.key_idea: Encode time gaps explicitly and preserve long-range context in a fixed-size memory bank supervised with cumulative summary statistics.
OaK72WNzTO.evidence: Experiments use CPSC-2021, VitalDB, MC-MED, and CHB-MIT for arrhythmia, sepsis, seizure detection, and forecasting with domain features and six foundation models.
OaK72WNzTO.claimed_gains: Across 21 dataset-feature settings, BioLT achieves the highest detection AUROC in 15 and the highest 20-minute forecasting AUROC in 13.

loGYX2xRu1.one_liner: A corrector trained on denoiser predictions repeatedly refines clean-sample estimates during diffusion sampling.
loGYX2xRu1.problem: Diffusion inference feeds earlier imperfect predictions into a denoiser trained on noisy real images, allowing errors to accumulate.
loGYX2xRu1.method: The corrector takes the base model's prediction and learns against the same clean target. At each denoising step, repeated correction refines the clean-sample estimate beyond the single correction supervised in training.
loGYX2xRu1.key_idea: Train on base-model predictions as inputs, then repeatedly correct the predicted clean sample within each denoising step.
loGYX2xRu1.evidence: The supplied text reports improved sample quality with largely preserved diversity and identifies repeated correction beyond the trained single step as necessary for the gains.

xL7T2h9rE4.one_liner: Shared hidden-state latents compress adjacent layers' KV caches without training and reconstruct layer-specific keys and values on demand.
xL7T2h9rE4.problem: Existing within-layer and cross-layer KV-cache compression methods lose substantial accuracy at high compression ratios.
xL7T2h9rE4.method: BellowsKV maps the similar input hidden states of adjacent layers into one shared latent per token without training. Each layer reads its own keys and values from that latent at inference time.
xL7T2h9rE4.key_idea: Represent adjacent layers' similar hidden states with one shared per-token latent from which their distinct keys and values are read.
xL7T2h9rE4.evidence: The abstract reports similar adjacent-layer input hidden states and greater accuracy loss from latent dimension reduction than quantization under the same memory budget.

creDoVOIXQ.one_liner: Step-level and trajectory-level preference optimization train a vision-language model to choose regional image-restoration actions.
creDoVOIXQ.problem: Globally uniform restoration overlooks regional degradation differences, while early restoration actions can hinder subsequent ones.
creDoVOIXQ.method: RegionAgent first applies step-level DPO using immediate restoration feedback to supervise differing action components. It then applies trajectory-level DPO using complete trajectory scores to supervise the sole differing action in each trajectory pair.
creDoVOIXQ.key_idea: Train regional restoration decisions using immediate-feedback preferences followed by full-trajectory preferences, supervising only the differing action component or action.

tUJBA5Ukzm.one_liner: Hard-Concrete gates prune LoRA expert counts and ranks, while prototype routing supplies task priors for continual learning.
tUJBA5Ukzm.problem: Fixed expert budgets waste capacity, and routing drift causes forgetting even when earlier experts remain frozen.
tUJBA5Ukzm.method: DyCapMoE gates new experts and their ranks with a sign-aware Hard-Concrete mechanism, pruning gates that reach zero at task end. A parameter-free prototype router supplies task-level inference priors using existing forward-pass features.
tUJBA5Ukzm.key_idea: Learn expert-count and rank sparsity through monotone Hard-Concrete gates, then combine accumulated experts with prototype-based task priors.
tUJBA5Ukzm.evidence: Experiments across continual-learning benchmarks on LVLMs and LLMs report improvements over existing methods.

2AjoIQdBPu.one_liner: Context-management actions maintain structured memory alongside UI actions for long-horizon mobile GUI tasks.
2AjoIQdBPu.problem: Passively accumulated interaction histories inflate prompts and dilute critical facts across long tasks and app transitions.
2AjoIQdBPu.method: MemGUI-Agent uses CONACT to let the same policy emit UI actions and context-management actions over folded action history, folded UI state, and recent step records. MemGUI-3K supplies annotated trajectories for supervised training.
2AjoIQdBPu.key_idea: Treat context updates as policy actions that maintain folded action history, folded UI state, and a recent step record.
2AjoIQdBPu.evidence: An 8B model trained on the 2,956-trajectory MemGUI-3K dataset is evaluated on source-aligned MemGUI-Bench.

JoQmrxygxH.one_liner: ODE Euler steps followed by Langevin correction provide stochastic flow-model RL rollouts aligned with inference dynamics.
JoQmrxygxH.problem: Finite-step stochastic training rollouts can diverge from deterministic inference trajectories and become blurry as exploration noise increases.
JoQmrxygxH.method: LC-GRPO follows each inference-aligned ODE Euler step with a Langevin correction targeting the resulting timestep's marginal. It recovers the score from flow velocity and retains isotropic Gaussian transitions with tractable likelihoods.
JoQmrxygxH.key_idea: Add a marginal-targeting Langevin correction after each ODE Euler step, deriving the correction score directly from flow velocity.
JoQmrxygxH.evidence: Conditional theory shows reduced Euler-step error and improved transitions over reverse-SDE Euler-Maruyama under matched randomness, and the abstract mentions SD3.5-Medium experiments.

GSjZHv2Qns.one_liner: Correct-answer and dominant-wrong-answer probabilities determine finite-budget plurality-accuracy bounds that expose misleading pass@K rankings.
GSjZHv2Qns.problem: Oracle coverage rankings can disagree with the accuracy of answers returned by deployed plurality selectors.
GSjZHv2Qns.method: The paper derives exact plurality-accuracy ranges from the probabilities of the correct and most frequent wrong answers, with extremal answer distributions. It also provides finite-sample bounds valid simultaneously across budgets without knowing the answer-support size.
GSjZHv2Qns.key_idea: Bound plurality accuracy using correct-answer mass and the largest wrong-answer mass rather than oracle coverage alone.
GSjZHv2Qns.evidence: Theoretical ranking reversals and accuracy bounds are supported by 44 systems from 11 model families and controlled GRPO experiments on MATH-500.
GSjZHv2Qns.claimed_gains: Choosing by pass@K can cost up to 19 points of plurality accuracy, while bounds estimated from a quarter of the deployment budget predict it to within about one and a half points and extrapolated pass@K overstates it by more than ten points.

IIkbYgIjIZ.one_liner: Conservative mesh convolution and separable linear attention combine local and global particle interactions with sign-split latent flux limiting.
IIkbYgIjIZ.problem: Graph-based neural Lagrangian simulators incur growing topology and message-passing costs and typically ignore conservation laws.
IIkbYgIjIZ.method: The simulator combines conservative mesh convolution for near-field interactions with conservative separable linear attention for long-range interactions. Sign-split latent flux limiters constrain concentration exchange while preserving conservative updates.
IIkbYgIjIZ.key_idea: Combine conservative local mesh transport and global linear attention, restricting concentration exchange through sign-split latent flux limiters.
IIkbYgIjIZ.evidence: Comparisons with GNN-based baselines report computational-efficiency and physical-consistency advantages, and the method connects discrete limiters to latent advection dynamics.
IIkbYgIjIZ.claimed_gains: The method supports up to 38× more particles than GNN-based baselines.

dgzXqSkwhs.one_liner: Alternating low- and high-data-volume phases balances stochastic regularization and update fidelity within a fixed cumulative training budget.
dgzXqSkwhs.problem: Fixed data-selection ratios constrain optimization by ignoring how data volume changes regularization and update fidelity during training.
dgzXqSkwhs.method: PODS analytically constructs an oscillatory data-volume schedule from a target ratio while preserving the prescribed cumulative budget. The schedule integrates with static or dynamic selectors without dataset-specific tuning.
dgzXqSkwhs.key_idea: Alternate low- and high-ratio data-selection phases under a fixed cumulative budget using an analytically determined schedule.
dgzXqSkwhs.evidence: Experiments across vision and language tasks report improved efficiency over fixed-ratio selection and mention ImageNet-1k.

H1Amw8PW81.one_liner: Reinforcement-learning exploration and conformal calibration exchange feedback to adapt forecasting intervals under non-stationarity.
H1Amw8PW81.problem: Adaptive conformal forecasting remains sensitive to outliers and systematic bias and separates calibration from model learning.
H1Amw8PW81.method: CORE treats conformal regression as sequential decision-making, using RL exploration to cover uncertain regions and inform calibration. Uncertainty-guided rewards feed interval information back into policy learning.
H1Amw8PW81.key_idea: Couple RL exploration with adaptive conformal calibration through exploration feedback and uncertainty-guided rewards.
H1Amw8PW81.evidence: The paper provides theoretical analysis and experiments across 9 standard time-series datasets against 7 baselines.
H1Amw8PW81.claimed_gains: CORE reports an averaged 1.38% improvement in interval length.

TnbNj06RfJ.one_liner: A neural pre-decoder commits syndrome-checked fault candidates and defers remaining quantum-code shots to a backend with posterior guidance.
TnbNj06RfJ.problem: Algorithmic quantum LDPC decoders require costly iterative inference, while standalone neural decoders often need large models and extensive data.
TnbNj06RfJ.method: CoD combines physical priors with GRU message passing on active detector subgraphs to estimate fault posteriors. It commits candidates only after full-DEM syndrome checks, optionally with local repair, and sends remaining shots and posteriors to a backend decoder.
TnbNj06RfJ.key_idea: Use local neural fault posteriors to propose corrections, commit only full-syndrome-checked candidates, and defer unresolved shots with posterior guidance.
TnbNj06RfJ.evidence: Circuit-level evaluation spans four code families and three backends, with additional code-capacity comparisons against a graph neural decoder on BB72 and BB144.
TnbNj06RfJ.claimed_gains: CoD lowers mean LER in all 20 code–backend configurations at p=0.002 by up to 48.5%, removes 90.4–99.8% of backend calls, and uses 42–56× fewer neural inference FLOPs than a standard graph neural decoder on BB72 and BB144 under code-capacity noise.

vWBRavgrbx.one_liner: Spectral-update analysis explains how Muon balances anisotropic residual-correction learning in deep residual networks.
vWBRavgrbx.problem: Deep linear product-based analyses do not explain spectral optimization when residual blocks remain near the identity yet their trainable corrections are anisotropic.
vWBRavgrbx.method: The paper analyzes gradient descent and spectral updates under anisotropic residual-branch geometry in deep linear networks. It identifies the residual correction, rather than the identity-stabilized full map, as the relevant conditioning problem.
vWBRavgrbx.key_idea: Separate the stable identity path from anisotropic residual corrections and analyze how spectral updates balance progress across unlearned correction directions.
vWBRavgrbx.evidence: Theoretical analysis of deep linear residual networks compares uneven correction-mode learning under gradient descent with balanced progress under spectral updates.

iwIxn4xDDN.one_liner: Interactive visual-enhancement policies use parsing utility and action-to-token distillation to improve document inputs across parsers.
iwIxn4xDDN.problem: Document parsers are vulnerable to visual degradation, and enhancement effects and tool choices vary across documents.
iwIxn4xDDN.method: AgenticDoc treats enhancement before parsing as an independently learnable interactive decision task guided by parsing utility. Action-to-Token On-Policy Distillation translates action-level teacher supervision into token-level generative-policy learning.
iwIxn4xDDN.key_idea: Optimize an interactive enhancement policy for parsing utility by translating action-level teacher supervision into token-level on-policy distillation.
iwIxn4xDDN.evidence: Evaluation covers 13 parsers on Wild-OmniDocBench, including nine absent from training feedback, plus OmniDocBench v1.6 and ten parsers on PureDocBench.
iwIxn4xDDN.claimed_gains: AgenticDoc reports average gains of 7.15 across all 13 Wild-OmniDocBench parsers and 7.44 across nine unseen parsers, a +0.41 average score change on OmniDocBench v1.6, and 2.48 across three PureDocBench scenarios.

lD8xxRxCes.one_liner: Kernel-embedded view distributions form a compact point-distribution graph for fusion and multi-view clustering.
lD8xxRxCes.problem: Existing multi-view clustering pipelines generally stop short of using distributional representations throughout representation, fusion, and final clustering.
lD8xxRxCes.method: DiFuMVC represents each view's component distributions with kernel mean embeddings and fuses views using shared reference-object identities. It assembles ordered view pairs into a point-distribution bipartite graph and applies transfer cut on the compact distribution side.
lD8xxRxCes.key_idea: Fuse kernel mean embeddings through shared references and cluster a point-distribution bipartite graph using its compact distribution side.
lD8xxRxCes.evidence: The paper proves cross-view kernel positive semidefiniteness, an expected-affinity interpretation, and conditional finite-sample spectral bounds, and reports benchmark experiments.

Je6lAhmpji.one_liner: Pre/post-RL log-policy ratios supply implicit token rewards for an extrapolated target distilled on-policy.
Je6lAhmpji.problem: RLVR reasoning gains require costly trajectory sampling under sparse feedback, leaving learned policy shifts underused for further improvement.
Je6lAhmpji.method: DIR extracts token-level implicit rewards from a fixed pair of pre- and post-RL checkpoints and uses a second regularized optimization anchored at the post-RL policy to construct an extrapolated target. It distills that target on-policy without an external teacher or separately trained reward model.
Je6lAhmpji.key_idea: Reuse a fixed RL checkpoint pair's log-policy ratio as an implicit reward to form and distill an extrapolated policy target.
Je6lAhmpji.evidence: An idealized KL-regularized reward correspondence motivates experiments on mathematical reasoning and agentic search, including initialization from intermediate RL checkpoints.

5SHxvjy15I.one_liner: Weaker-policy rollouts expose negatively preferred tokens to teacher supervision during on-policy distillation.
5SHxvjy15I.problem: Limited distributional overlap between a stronger teacher and its student can leave on-policy distillation with insufficient learning signals.
5SHxvjy15I.method: NP-OPD complements student rollouts with rollouts from a lower-performing negative policy. This continually exposes tokens favored by the negative policy over the teacher to the existing teacher-supervision objective.
5SHxvjy15I.key_idea: Add weaker negative-policy rollouts so their preferred tokens repeatedly receive teacher supervision without changing the distillation reward formulation.
5SHxvjy15I.evidence: Experiments report improved OPD across model scales, generation modes, reasoning domains, and OPD variants.

tz4ZUcL75E.one_liner: Binary expert masks allocate computation across tokens and layers while self-distillation preserves a frozen MoE model's behavior.
tz4ZUcL75E.problem: Fixed Top-K routing wastes expert computation, while aggressive skipping harms quality and joint router-expert adaptation is expensive.
tz4ZUcL75E.method: BEAM combines hidden states with routing priors to select candidate experts through learned masks under a shared sparsity objective. Layer-wise self-distillation preserves original representations and predictions while pretrained weights remain frozen.
tz4ZUcL75E.key_idea: Learn binary expert masks under a global sparsity objective and layer-wise self-distillation, allocating expert budgets across tokens and layers.
tz4ZUcL75E.evidence: Evaluation on Qwen3-30B-A3B measures retained model performance and reduced expert activations.
tz4ZUcL75E.claimed_gains: On Qwen3-30B-A3B, BEAM preserves over 99% of original performance while reducing expert activations by 50%.

2LgNhdTelM.one_liner: Geometric alignment preserves solution-directed reasoning text and compresses deviating steps into continuous latent tokens.
2LgNhdTelM.problem: Chain-of-thought incurs computation and context costs, while hard pruning discards intermediate information and continuous compression lacks a principled criterion.
2LgNhdTelM.method: A*-Thought-V2 projects question, step, and solution representations into 3D PCA space and measures local transitions against the question-to-solution direction. It retains aligned steps as text and trains latent tokens for deviating steps using pooled embeddings and soft vocabulary labels.
2LgNhdTelM.key_idea: Use transition angles relative to the question-to-solution direction to interleave explicit reasoning text with compressed latent representations of deviating steps.
2LgNhdTelM.evidence: The abstract reports directional-angle analyses and experiments on Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.6-27B, but truncates the evaluation-setting description.

VRLUtnC2oZ.one_liner: Controlled full-duplex speech-model experiments isolate sequence layout, training objectives, text guidance, and dialogue-data choices.
VRLUtnC2oZ.problem: Existing full-duplex speech systems combine differing architectures, backbones, objectives, and data recipes, obscuring which design choices drive behavior.
VRLUtnC2oZ.method: The study uses a shared pipeline and two open speech-language backbones to vary channel layout and speech granularity, duplex objectives, text guidance, and real versus synthetic dialogue. It compares dialogue quality, interruption behavior, latency, and spoken question answering.
VRLUtnC2oZ.key_idea: Hold the training pipeline shared while varying duplex layout, prediction objectives, text-guidance granularity, and dialogue-data source across two backbones.
VRLUtnC2oZ.evidence: Controlled experiments across two open SLM backbones and tested speech chunk sizes report configuration-dependent quality and interruption tradeoffs, including spoken QA on GLM-4-Voice.

n7jt1Tnxzl.one_liner: Controlled comparisons across workflows and team configurations evaluate system-prompt optimization for multi-agent LLM systems.
n7jt1Tnxzl.problem: The conditions and magnitude of multi-agent prompt-optimization gains remain unclear as the prompt search space grows with system configuration.
n7jt1Tnxzl.method: MAS-PromptBench varies task, workflow, communication protocol, and team size while benchmarking multi-agent extensions of single-agent prompt optimizers alongside optimizers designed for multi-agent systems.
n7jt1Tnxzl.key_idea: Vary multi-agent system configurations and compare prompt optimizers across tasks, workflows, communication protocols, and team sizes.
n7jt1Tnxzl.evidence: The study benchmarks both adapted single-agent and dedicated multi-agent prompt optimizers across multiple system setups.

ljWuPSZc27.one_liner: Recursive task-interface composition tests spatial-context propagation between object-level workspace reasoning and environment-level transit reasoning.
ljWuPSZc27.problem: Existing benchmarks underrepresent multi-step spatial reasoning that crosses local and global scales.
ljWuPSZc27.method: MindTraverse recursively composes atomic task interfaces into multi-step problems and validates them geometrically and visually. Models must propagate spatial context between fine-grained workspace and coarse-grained transit reasoning.
ljWuPSZc27.key_idea: Recursively compose atomic spatial tasks so models must carry context between local workspace and global transit reasoning.
ljWuPSZc27.evidence: The benchmark contains 6,167 multi-view questions across 35 composition templates, six scale sequences, and 210 simulator scenes, evaluated with 20 model configurations.
ljWuPSZc27.claimed_gains: The best-performing model achieves 50.92% overall accuracy across 20 model configurations.

zXIwNwwUJg.one_liner: Dimension-specific feature subspaces and asymmetric hierarchical alignment link CT lesions to decomposed radiology-report semantics.
zXIwNwwUJg.problem: Medical vision-language pretraining struggles with sparse lesion-specific report information and missing lesion-level anchors during alignment.
zXIwNwwUJg.method: Lesion-CLIP decomposes CT scans and reports into five semantic dimensions, projects image features into dimension-specific subspaces, and performs asymmetric dimension-level and lesion-level alignment. LiLA supplies pathology-calibrated lesion annotations for type, size, location, phase, and attribute.
zXIwNwwUJg.key_idea: Disentangle semantic dimensions into image-feature subspaces and align reports asymmetrically at dimension and lesion levels.
zXIwNwwUJg.evidence: Experiments on the curated LiLA 3D CT dataset and public MSWAL evaluate discriminative and generative tasks, including zero-shot comparisons with fully supervised models.

pWPrqlYTnl.one_liner: Signed loss feedback drives adaptive remote-prompt retrieval under a communication budget in personalized federated learning.
pWPrqlYTnl.problem: Fixed-size nearest-neighbor prompt retrieval ignores directed, changing, and potentially harmful transfer between clients.
pWPrqlYTnl.method: Clients attribute signed gated-mixture loss improvements to remote experts through class-conditional gate attention. The server estimates directed utility, balances exploitation with uncertainty and freshness, adjusts retrieval counts under a hard budget, and filters repeatedly harmful pairs.
pWPrqlYTnl.key_idea: Use client-attributed signed loss gains to estimate directed expert utility and adapt prompt retrieval while filtering persistently harmful transfers.
pWPrqlYTnl.evidence: The supplied abstract reports evaluation on nine datasets and two backbones but truncates the results.

QwSebSpSXN.one_liner: Searchable frame-linked history combines recent and distant visual evidence for query-specific streaming video answers.
QwSebSpSXN.problem: Fixed frame selection and prewritten event descriptions cannot preserve or expose every question's relevant evidence under finite streaming-video context.
QwSebSpSXN.method: StreamWeave builds a searchable visual history linked to original frames as video arrives. At query time, recent and broader look-back evidence supports an initial answer or a request for additional source frames through retrieval.
QwSebSpSXN.key_idea: Link visual history to original frames, combine recent and look-back evidence, and retrieve additional frames when the model requests them.
QwSebSpSXN.evidence: Experiments cover three streaming-video benchmarks and five frozen MLLMs ranging from an 8B dense model to a 397B mixture-of-experts model, with component, layout, and retrieval ablations.

H0JCd3MMZZ.one_liner: Relation-aware token bottlenecking and semantic-shift alignment transfer reference-image relations while preserving source-image content.
H0JCd3MMZZ.problem: Reference appearance can overwhelm relational cues, and coordinated pose edits can accumulate unwanted identity, background, and style changes during denoising.
H0JCd3MMZZ.method: The method uses relation-aware token bottleneck attention to disentangle reference relation semantics from appearance. Semantic-shift alignment constrains denoising-induced changes while transferring the reference relation to the source image.
H0JCd3MMZZ.key_idea: Isolate reference relation cues through token bottlenecking and constrain denoising-induced semantic shifts during relation transfer.

xCJZZJ4opT.one_liner: Stage-specific affine edits map concept activations to anchors within a constrained embedding-difference subspace for text-to-3D erasure.
xCJZZJ4opT.problem: Single-pathway concept erasure methods do not account for separate structural and appearance stages in native 3D generators.
xCJZZJ4opT.method: STAGE confines closed-form least-squares affine corrections to the subspace spanned by erase-anchor embedding differences and penalizes displacement of retained prompts. It edits structural stages for shape and object concepts and appearance stages for material concepts.
xCJZZJ4opT.key_idea: Apply least-squares affine corrections within erase-anchor difference subspaces at concept-appropriate generative stages while penalizing changes to retained prompts.
xCJZZJ4opT.evidence: Experiments on TRELLIS cover 15 shape, material, and object concepts and assess a composite balance between forgetting and preservation.
xCJZZJ4opT.claimed_gains: STAGE reaches 66.7 on a composite score balancing target-concept forgetting and preservation on TRELLIS across 15 concepts.

Nz8coUtXuI.one_liner: Differentiable top-k feature-class selection jointly trains sparse autoencoder features and their class annotations.
Nz8coUtXuI.problem: Post-hoc matching of frozen sparse-autoencoder dictionaries to target concepts limits reliable editing and steering.
Nz8coUtXuI.method: ClasSAE applies differentiable top-k selection to a trainable feature-class affinity matrix with per-feature budgets. Gradients through feature selection jointly adapt the encoder and affinity matrix, with three sparsity-enforcement variants.
Nz8coUtXuI.key_idea: Backpropagate through top-k selection on a trainable feature-class affinity matrix so active features and their class assignments co-adapt.
Nz8coUtXuI.evidence: The abstract reports comparable overall performance for three sparsity variants and mentions CLIP ViT-L/14 embeddings but truncates the evaluation setup.

OZHyyRWCZW.one_liner: Set-conditioned DPP marginal contributions allocate high-fidelity context while discounting already-preserved evidence.
OZHyyRWCZW.problem: Fixed segment-wise importance scores ignore whether selected context already contains a segment's information.
OZHyyRWCZW.method: ReValue derives compact query-aware segment representations and builds a Determinantal Point Process objective combining query-conditioned quality with multi-scale semantic overlap. It reassesses each segment's marginal contribution as the high-fidelity set grows.
OZHyyRWCZW.key_idea: Score each segment's marginal contribution to a query-conditioned DPP objective relative to the evolving high-fidelity context set.

9gO5IncEU5.one_liner: Alternating cost exploration and feasibility repair coordinate routing searches through accumulated disagreement and learned coupling.
9gO5IncEU5.problem: Reducing route cost can conflict with restoring feasibility under hard operational constraints.
9gO5IncEU5.method: ALTER alternates cost-oriented exploration with feasibility-oriented repair, using each selected route as the reference for the other search. Accumulated disagreement links iterations, and a learned state-dependent coupling strength regulates coordination.
9gO5IncEU5.key_idea: Alternate exploration and repair proposals around each other's selected routes, carrying disagreement across iterations with learned state-dependent coupling.
9gO5IncEU5.evidence: The analysis identifies coupling intervals for feasible cost improvements, and experiments cover synthetic single- and multi-vehicle routing including hard 100-customer draft-limit instances.
9gO5IncEU5.claimed_gains: ALTER produces feasible outputs for 99.97% of hard 100-customer draft-limit instances and obtains the lowest gap among tested neural methods.

kd8dasdPSk.one_liner: Replaying successful trajectories mitigates forgetting caused by evolving on-policy training distributions in language-model reinforcement learning.
kd8dasdPSk.problem: On-policy RL can lose previously accessible behaviors because the evolving model changes its own effective training distribution.
kd8dasdPSk.method: The study isolates endogenous forgetting by comparing temporal and shuffled supervised training orders over successful RL traces. It then evaluates successful-trajectory replay during RL post-training.
kd8dasdPSk.key_idea: Replay successful trajectories to revisit behaviors that an evolving on-policy data distribution would otherwise stop supporting.
kd8dasdPSk.evidence: Controlled trace-order experiments and evaluations across reasoning tasks and model families compare forgetting, prompt-level oscillations, pass@1, and solution coverage with standard RL.

RG8fVAHaD5.one_liner: Structural alignment scores and Fourier-aggregated continuous match votes estimate cross-view yaw under uncertain camera position.
RG8fVAHaD5.problem: Single-direction match votes leave many plausible headings, while hard-bin voting over all position-match pairs is costly and piecewise constant.
RG8fVAHaD5.method: S-RAY learns structural yaw scores from pose labels to shortlist headings at each position, then resolves candidates using continuous match votes. Learned cosine-based bumps at implied yaws turn scoring into FFT correlations without forming position-match pairs.
RG8fVAHaD5.key_idea: Combine pose-supervised structural yaw scores with continuous match-vote bumps evaluated through cosine expansions and FFT correlations.
RG8fVAHaD5.evidence: The abstract describes an FFT-based reduction of continuous yaw-vote scoring but does not report experiments.

ldt49frS59.one_liner: Rigidly transformed canonical object meshes condition depth videos that guide camera and object motion in video generation.
ldt49frS59.problem: Image-plane controls are ambiguous in depth and rotation, while incomplete 3D tracks or blobs lose consistency across viewpoints.
ldt49frS59.method: 4Director reconstructs each object once as a canonical mesh and applies a prescribed rigid transformation per frame. A Motion Adapter converts depth renders of the controlled scene into videos with view-consistent appearance, illumination, and non-rigid dynamics.
ldt49frS59.key_idea: Move canonical object meshes with prescribed per-frame rigid transforms and use their depth renders to condition a video Motion Adapter.
ldt49frS59.evidence: Experiments compare visual quality and camera and object control with prior methods, using the 20,774-clip RealCOD-Rigid training dataset and introducing Identity-Gated IoU.

g9vPJ6jT9C.one_liner: Codebook-conditioned expert composition produces reusable blocks that sparsely execute while drawing from the entire expert pool.
g9vPJ6jT9C.problem: Existing MoE designs cannot independently control expert participation, execution cost, and the number of materialized parameter sets.
g9vPJ6jT9C.method: RecipeMoE uses a small learned codebook and hypernetwork to compose cacheable blocks from every expert in each internal layer's pool. Sparse routing selects a few blocks per token, while Dual-Path Residual Gating supports nonlinear interactions between composed paths.
g9vPJ6jT9C.key_idea: Generate a fixed set of codebook-conditioned blocks by merging entire expert pools, then sparsely route tokens to those reusable blocks.
g9vPJ6jT9C.evidence: The TL;DR reports consistent gains across three prediction tasks and a large-scale online deployment without naming datasets or metrics.

vFJIY1xR2a.one_liner: Rubric-guided search and final-segment reinforcement learning teach agents to manage context and verify answers over long searches.
vFJIY1xR2a.problem: Long searches accumulate misleading context that preserves early mistakes and makes recovery difficult.
vFJIY1xR2a.method: Traverse cycles through Rubric, Answer, and Verify states and uses Seal Memory for active context management. Reinforcement learning trains only the final segment after context management to address Seal Collapse.
vFJIY1xR2a.key_idea: Train only the final post-compression segment while an agent manages memory and cycles through rubric construction, search, and independent verification.
vFJIY1xR2a.evidence: A 35B model is evaluated on five search benchmarks, financial investigation, and product search, with ablations comparing autonomous compression and automatic compaction.
vFJIY1xR2a.claimed_gains: The 35B model achieves 72.83 on BrowseComp and improves over its base model on all five search benchmarks.

VnRf54qkjE.one_liner: Attention-response matching guides training-free merging of historical KV states for long-video generation under fixed cache budgets.
VnRf54qkjE.problem: Fixed KV-cache budgets can discard historical content needed for consistent long-video generation.
VnRf54qkjE.method: FrameFold merges adjacent historical KV entries into representatives while retaining complete spatial grids. It fits value-merging coefficients by closed-form conditional attention-response matching and selects the merge with the lowest residual distortion.
VnRf54qkjE.key_idea: Fit merged values to preserve historical-query attention responses, then choose the adjacent-entry merge with minimum residual response distortion.
VnRf54qkjE.evidence: Matched-budget experiments use Self Forcing and Causal Forcing at 30 and 60 seconds and LongLive at 120 seconds.

DleXZVKICI.one_liner: Shallow geometry features select frames before encoding, while model sensitivity and 3D coordinates guide subsequent token pruning.
DleXZVKICI.problem: Spatial MLLMs incur redundant geometric encoding and token-processing costs that pruning only after encoding cannot address.
DleXZVKICI.method: GRAFT selects views using shallow frozen-backbone features that assess cross-view relations and temporal coverage. After encoding, it selects semantic evidence by model sensitivity and corrects spatially invalid substitutions using aligned 3D coordinates.
DleXZVKICI.key_idea: Route frames before full geometry encoding, then select model-sensitive tokens and correct substitutions using aligned 3D coordinates under an exact budget.
DleXZVKICI.evidence: The abstract reports experiments on three benchmarks without naming them or providing their results.

0FjWo4CGTU.one_liner: Atom-level affinity and steric-overlap encoding incorporates competing ligands into drug-target bioactivity prediction.
0FjWo4CGTU.problem: Single-ligand prediction ignores competing ligands whose binding strength and spatial overlap affect measured bioactivity.
0FjWo4CGTU.method: DrugComp encodes atom-level binding affinities and steric overlaps within shared protein pockets for graph neural networks and transformers. CompDB supplies radioligand displacement assays with docking-derived structural context.
0FjWo4CGTU.key_idea: Encode relative binding affinities and steric overlaps between test ligands and competing radioligands within the same protein pocket.
0FjWo4CGTU.evidence: Five-fold cross-validation uses CompDB's 10,675 assays spanning 151 proteins, 181 radioligands, and 8,674 test ligands across multiple backbone architectures.
0FjWo4CGTU.claimed_gains: DrugComp reports up to 44.7% improvement in bioactivity prediction metrics over competition-blind baselines.

C9ArZzGcwi.one_liner: Measured 3D interventions set preference margins and cross-view constraints for spatial vision-language learning.
C9ArZzGcwi.problem: Vision-language models contradict themselves across views and fail to respond to changed spatial relations because supervision leaves geometric dependencies implicit.
C9ArZzGcwi.method: GaugeVLM generates linked observations through controlled object and camera interventions in explicit 3D scenes. GaugeDPO maps measured errors to preference margins, supervises canonical rankings across views, and relates answer-odds contrasts to measured spatial changes.
C9ArZzGcwi.key_idea: Convert measured geometric errors into preference margins and constrain cross-view rankings and intervention-induced answer-odds changes.
C9ArZzGcwi.evidence: Analysis bounds canonical prediction error and shows joint constraint satisfiability; experiments cover three VLM backbones, established spatial metrics, autonomous driving, and embodied reasoning.
C9ArZzGcwi.claimed_gains: GaugeVLM improves all 10 established spatial metrics over supervised fine-tuning, with its main 7B model gaining 15.0 and 18.9 percentage points on MSMU distance and QSpatial+, respectively.

cZrmSh2ElM.one_liner: Block-wise continuous algebraic invariants support proactive image-tampering localization, with network augmentation addressing natural-image limitations.
cZrmSh2ElM.problem: Existing proactive image defenses lack algebraic foundations, while classical coding and sparse-recovery assumptions do not directly fit continuous pixels and large edits.
cZrmSh2ElM.method: Continuous Syndrome Forensics extends syndrome verification to continuous spatial data through block-wise algebraic invariants. SyndromeMark adds a network to address host self-interference and underdetermination under large-area manipulation.
cZrmSh2ElM.key_idea: Impose block-wise algebraic invariants on continuous image data to localize tampering without global sparse-recovery optimization.

91fH4tghz3.one_liner: Models PDE turbulence closure on normalized physical scales using dual spectral-spatial branches and low-rank bottleneck-MLP convolution kernels.
91fH4tghz3.problem: Coarse-grid PDE neural operators often overfit grid-specific patterns rather than capturing low-rank, scale-invariant turbulence closure laws.
91fH4tghz3.method: Scale-Invariant Neural Operator (SINO) operates on normalized physical scales through a dual-branch spectral and spatial architecture in which bottleneck MLPs generate continuous convolution kernels with an explicit low-rank inductive bias.
91fH4tghz3.key_idea: Learn PDE operators on normalized physical scales via a dual spectral-spatial architecture whose bottleneck MLPs generate low-rank continuous convolution kernels.
91fH4tghz3.evidence: Evaluated via kernel PCA and parameter-scaling benchmarks against U-Net, DeepONet, Transolver, Oformer, GK-Transformer, FNO, AMFNO, and UFNO across forced/decaying Burgers, Kuramoto-Sivashinsky, and forced/decaying Navier-Stokes turbulence closure tasks.
91fH4tghz3.claimed_gains: Concentrates over 95% of kernel variance into 2–3 PCA modes and achieves 38x steeper parameter-scaling-law exponents than FNO.

2D3yFJhKsI.one_liner: Downweights spatiotemporal consistency distillation losses exponentially using local disagreement against consensus endpoints from dual perturbed teacher paths.
2D3yFJhKsI.problem: Uniform spatiotemporal consistency penalties in few-step video distillation become unstable in high-motion regions such as flowing water or moving foliage shadows.
2D3yFJhKsI.method: Uncertainty-Aware Consistency Distillation (UACD) constructs two independently perturbed teacher-guided consistency trajectories whose student endpoint predictions form a consensus target, uses the discrepancy between the student's direct prediction and this target as a parameter-free local uncertainty proxy, and exponentially downweights consistency losses in high-uncertainty spatiotemporal regions.
2D3yFJhKsI.key_idea: Estimate parameter-free spatiotemporal consistency uncertainty from the discrepancy between direct student predictions and a dual-perturbed teacher-path consensus endpoint, exponentially downweighting uncertain regions.
2D3yFJhKsI.evidence: Evaluated on 4-step consistency distillation for few-step video generation.

ZsaL6YMViH.one_liner: Converts static post-trained MoE LLMs into dynamic MoEs via parameter-free zero-expert injection and two-stage self-distillation.
ZsaL6YMViH.problem: Dynamic Mixture-of-Experts methods typically require costly pretraining from scratch or narrow task-specific tuning rather than converting already post-trained static MoE models.
ZsaL6YMViH.method: Zero-Expert Self-Distillation Adaptation (ZEDA) injects parameter-free zero-output experts into each MoE layer so easy tokens can bypass expert computation. It stabilizes the conversion via two-stage self-distillation using the frozen original MoE as teacher alongside a group-level load-balancing loss.
ZsaL6YMViH.key_idea: Inject parameter-free zero-output experts into post-trained MoE layers and adapt routing via two-stage self-distillation from the frozen original MoE teacher with group-level balancing.
ZsaL6YMViH.evidence: Evaluated by converting Qwen3-30B-A3B and GLM-4.7-Flash across 11 math, code, and instruction-following benchmarks.
ZsaL6YMViH.claimed_gains: Eliminates over 50% of expert FLOPs at marginal accuracy loss, outperforms the strongest dynamic MoE baseline by 11.7 and 14.9 points on Qwen3-30B-A3B and GLM-4.7-Flash, and achieves ~1.20x end-to-end inference speedup.

QfQfW7NwPh.one_liner: Accelerates autoregressive image generation using a semantic Canvas-Token bottleneck, diffusion pixel rendering, sparse training, and parameter-free draft decoding.
QfQfW7NwPh.problem: Reconstruction-oriented visual tokenizers produce long, redundant token sequences that make high-resolution autoregressive image training and decoding computationally expensive.
QfQfW7NwPh.method: CanvasFlash replaces pixel-reconstruction tokenization with a semantic image tokenizer coupled to a diffusion pixel decoder, concentrating non-informative regions onto a shared Canvas Token. It exploits this concentration via Canvas-Sparse Training on informative tokens, Canvas-as-Draft speculative decoding using the Canvas Token as a parameter-free draft, and reinforcement learning.
QfQfW7NwPh.key_idea: Tokenize images semantically so redundant regions share a common Canvas Token, enabling sparse-token training and speculative draft decoding with pixel rendering delegated to a diffusion decoder.
QfQfW7NwPh.evidence: Evaluated on high-resolution autoregressive image generation training cost, decoding latency, and generation quality.
QfQfW7NwPh.claimed_gains: Canvas-Sparse Training processes 41% of full-sequence tokens, while Canvas-as-Draft Decoding achieves up to 3.09x autoregressive decoding speedup and 2.06x end-to-end speedup including diffusion rendering.

EiCbKWR16T.one_liner: Composes a frozen VLA contact primitive with fixed analytic primitives under a trace-learned memory-guided planning harness.
EiCbKWR16T.problem: End-to-end VLA policies degrade under out-of-distribution semantic, spatial, and contact perturbations, while purely analytic coding-agent primitives fail on irregular grasping and articulated contact.
EiCbKWR16T.method: Harness VLA wraps a frozen VLA as a retryable local contact-rich primitive and composes it with a fixed library of analytic primitives for grounding, staging, transport, navigation, and release. Memory-guided agents learn primitive operating ranges from execution traces, global success rules, and failure models while handling semantic re-grounding and VLA re-staging.
EiCbKWR16T.key_idea: Expose a frozen VLA solely as a retryable contact-rich primitive composed with fixed analytic staging/transport primitives whose operating ranges are learned in memory from execution traces.
EiCbKWR16T.evidence: Evaluated without VLA fine-tuning across perturbed tabletop, household kitchen, and clean-to-randomized robotic manipulation tasks.

ms8Vo8fyAZ.one_liner: Decouples histopathology nucleus localization and prototype-distilled typing from geometry prediction using compact low-order Fourier contours.
ms8Vo8fyAZ.problem: Joint histopathology nuclei analysis pipelines expend substantial compute on dense pixel-mask decoders even though nuclear shapes require very few geometric degrees of freedom.
ms8Vo8fyAZ.method: Motivated by empirical low-order saturation of Fourier nuclear boundaries, LiNA (Lightweight Nuclei Analysis) decouples point-first nucleus localization and prototype-distilled cell typing from shape decoding by predicting compact low-order Fourier contours.
ms8Vo8fyAZ.key_idea: Separate point-based nucleus detection and prototype-distilled classification from boundary decoding by representing each nuclear contour with a low-order Fourier series instead of a dense mask.
ms8Vo8fyAZ.evidence: Fourier contour order sweeps across four histopathology datasets and controlled comparisons across four backbone scales replacing LiNA's Fourier head with a matched dense-mask decoder.
ms8Vo8fyAZ.claimed_gains: Order N = 1 and N = 15 Fourier contours reconstruct ground-truth nuclei at 85–89% and 98.5–99.1% IoU across four datasets, and LiNA matches a dense-mask decoder on all task metrics while avoiding up to 6.4x higher computation.

NcnAlaUt76.one_liner: Executes multiple confidence-gated speculative drafting loops before a single target verification pass using loop-aware draft training.
NcnAlaUt76.problem: Standard speculative decoding invokes a costly target-model verification pass after every single drafting stage even when a confident autoregressive or parallel draft model could continue drafting.
NcnAlaUt76.method: DLoop adaptively runs multiple drafting stages while the draft model remains confident and verifies all accumulated draft tokens in one combined target-model forward pass. Loop-aware training exposes the draft model to its own unverified hidden states so parallel and autoregressive drafters stay accurate across chained loops.
NcnAlaUt76.key_idea: Chain multiple confidence-gated drafting stages prior to joint target-model verification while training the draft model on its own unverified hidden states across loops.
NcnAlaUt76.evidence: Evaluated across autoregressive and parallel speculative decoding frameworks including EAGLE-3, DFlash, Domino, and DSpark.

vHwd53LkMk.one_liner: Identifiability bounds prove masked prediction needs low-visibility mask mass to recover global mode weights under small excess risk.
vHwd53LkMk.problem: Masked prediction trained only on high-visibility contexts can attain exponentially small excess risk while misestimating global mixture mode weights.
vHwd53LkMk.method: On finite product spaces under joint masked-block log loss, the paper defines an ε-identifiability modulus measuring worst-case joint-distribution recovery error at population excess risk ε. Using an information decomposition and two-sided bounds, it characterizes mode-reweighting sensitivity via schedule-averaged residual mode uncertainty and shows how low-visibility and full-mask probabilities restore joint KL control.
vHwd53LkMk.key_idea: Bound joint-distribution identifiability via schedule-averaged residual mode uncertainty, allocating mask schedule mass to low-visibility and full masks where context leaves modes uncertain.
vHwd53LkMk.evidence: Supported by theoretical two-sided identifiability bounds on finite product spaces, exact calculations, and controlled gradient-optimization experiments.

Ib22Ap1X1P.one_liner: Randomly projected key-sensitivity fingerprints and functional non-maximum suppression prune redundant visual tokens in vision-language-action models without training.
Ib22Ap1X1P.problem: Importance-only visual token pruning in vision-language-action models retains functionally redundant tokens whose removals shift intermediate action representations in similar directions.
Ib22Ap1X1P.method: At an early attention layer, PFT-Prune computes the local sensitivity of an intermediate action-related representation to each visual token's key and applies shared random projections to build a compact policy-functional fingerprint (PFF). Functional NMS combines PFF energy for priority with pairwise fingerprint alignment to suppress redundant tokens under an exact budget before physical pruning.
Ib22Ap1X1P.key_idea: Project action-representation sensitivity to visual keys into compact fingerprints and apply functional non-maximum suppression to select influential, directionally diverse tokens.
Ib22Ap1X1P.evidence: Evaluated training-free on π0.5 and OpenVLA-OFT across four LIBERO benchmark suites and on five physical-robot manipulation tasks.
Ib22Ap1X1P.claimed_gains: On four LIBERO suites at 20% token retention, PFT-Prune reaches 94.1% and 93.2% average success on π0.5 and OpenVLA-OFT with 1.23× and 1.59× speedups, and achieves 1.22× speedup at 50% retention on five physical-robot tasks while preserving 95.2% of π0.5 success.

KG8HVheDgb.one_liner: Self-retrospection distillation transfers privileged hindsight from completed agent rollouts into pre-interaction foresight targets of the same policy.
KG8HVheDgb.problem: Group-relative reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards loses gradient signal when all sampled rollouts receive identical rewards despite informative failures in their trajectories.
KG8HVheDgb.method: Self-Retrospection Distillation (SRD) extracts useful knowledge and failure pitfalls from completed post-hoc trajectories as privileged hindsight and distills them into trajectory-blind pre-interaction foresight predictions of the same policy. Foresight acts purely as an auxiliary training target and is not generated at inference time.
KG8HVheDgb.key_idea: Distill post-hoc insights from completed trajectories into pre-interaction foresight predictions of the same policy so reward-uniform rollout groups still provide supervision.
KG8HVheDgb.evidence: Evaluated across 10 tool-integrated reasoning and long-horizon agentic tasks alongside RLVR and self-distillation baselines across model scales including a 2B setting.
KG8HVheDgb.claimed_gains: SRD yields gains of up to 24.2 percentage points across 10 tasks while exploiting rollout groups where 37%–98% of groups receive uniform rewards.

rJogZh6P0w.one_liner: Missed-task conditional greedy queries and committee-lottery approximations select k-member model ensembles under binary and pairwise feedback.
rJogZh6P0w.problem: Selecting a small ensemble of complementary models or solvers is query-expensive under binary evaluations and vulnerable to majority cycles under pairwise comparisons.
rJogZh6P0w.method: For binary correctness queries, a conditional greedy algorithm evaluates candidate additions exclusively on tasks missed by the current committee, exploiting missed-task agreement to reduce query complexity. For pairwise feedback, the paper formulates an omitted-candidate dominance objective and analyzes deterministic PTAS/Gap-ETH limits alongside randomized lotteries over committees.
rJogZh6P0w.key_idea: Query candidate additions only on tasks missed by the partial committee for binary feedback, and optimize omitted-candidate dominance or committee lotteries under pairwise feedback.
rJogZh6P0w.evidence: Supported by high-probability (1 − 1/e)OPT_k − ε coverage and query-complexity bounds for binary feedback, plus PTAS and randomized Gap-ETH hardness results for pairwise rankings.
rJogZh6P0w.claimed_gains: The conditional greedy binary-feedback algorithm attains coverage at least (1 − 1/e)OPT_k − ε with high probability while accounting for missed-task discovery queries.

uWLxfkeDBy.one_liner: Motion decomposition, species-routed LoRA expression encoders, and adversarial domain adaptation transfer facial animations across species without identity leakage.
uWLxfkeDBy.problem: Animating a portrait of one species from a driving video of another suffers from driving-species anatomical leakage due to cross-species facial structure differences.
uWLxfkeDBy.method: CrossPortrait decomposes motion into rigid head poses and facial expression keypoints, encoding expressions through a unified encoder equipped with species-routed LoRA modules. Expression-level adversarial domain adaptation suppresses driving-species-specific cues to align expressions in a shared cross-species latent space.
uWLxfkeDBy.key_idea: Decompose motion into head pose and expression keypoints, then align expressions across species using species-routed LoRA encoders and expression-level adversarial domain adaptation.
uWLxfkeDBy.evidence: Evaluated on human-to-animal, animal-to-human, and animal-to-animal (such as cat-to-dog) portrait animation scenarios.

VKANZmxzaP.one_liner: Windowed coordinate autoregression compresses prior detection windows into fixed latent tokens to prevent box-repetition loops in dense grounding.
VKANZmxzaP.problem: Autoregressive MLLM object detectors collapse into repeated bounding-box loops in dense scenes because growing histories of coordinate tokens monopolize attention over visual features.
VKANZmxzaP.method: WinARDet partitions long detection sequences into consecutive generation windows, restricting full token-level autoregression to the active window while compressing each completed window into a fixed set of latent conditioning tokens. This bounds exposure to raw historical coordinates while preserving cross-window context for multi-object grounding.
VKANZmxzaP.key_idea: Restrict token-level coordinate autoregression to local generation windows and compress completed windows into fixed-size latent tokens to prevent historical-coordinate attention takeover.
VKANZmxzaP.evidence: Evaluated on RSDense (200–2,000 objects per image) over RexOmni and across alternative decoding strategies including parallel box decoding.
VKANZmxzaP.claimed_gains: On RSDense, WinARDet improves RexOmni F1-score (IoU=0.5) from 32.16 to 39.36 while reducing box redundancy from 35.48% to 13.00%.

jOFCJVBaVA.one_liner: Empirical study separates exact top-k attention retrievability from ANN index recall limits and calibrates static head-aware sparsity budgets.
jOFCJVBaVA.problem: Long-context sparse attention conflates whether exact top-k keys suffice to approximate full attention with whether approximate nearest neighbor indexes can actually retrieve those keys.
jOFCJVBaVA.method: The study separately evaluates exact top-k attention mass coverage, cross-input head retrievability stability, and off-the-shelf ANN index recall (IVF, HNSW, PQ). Leveraging stable head-level retrievability rankings across inputs and decoding steps, it allocates a one-time calibrated head-aware top-k budget.
jOFCJVBaVA.key_idea: Decouple exact top-k attention retrievability from ANN search recall and allocate per-head key budgets using input-invariant head retrievability profiles.
jOFCJVBaVA.evidence: Evaluated on Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen3-8B across RULER (13 tasks), LongBench, and LongProc using exact top-k and IVF, HNSW, and PQ indexes.
jOFCJVBaVA.claimed_gains: Head retrievability shows held-out rank correlation of approximately 0.97, and a once-calibrated head-aware budget improves task scores by up to 7.3 points over a matched uniform budget.

5ufwDMSmQT.one_liner: Caption-annealed joint audio-video diffusion adaptation and one-step MeanFlow distillation restore coupled visual and acoustic degradations in archival footage.
5ufwDMSmQT.problem: Separate audio and visual restoration pipelines fail to exploit cross-modal cues in coupled archival degradations, while direct prompt-free adaptation increases optimization variance.
5ufwDMSmQT.method: OmniVR adapts a pretrained text-to-audio-video generator on synthetic paired degradations using degraded audio-video conditioning while progressively annealing per-sample captions into a fixed text-free restoration prompt with caption/null rehearsal. OmniVR-Flash accelerates deployment via reduced-resolution video conditioning, MeanFlow one-step distillation, and Turbo VAE, accompanied by the OmniVRBench evaluation suite.
5ufwDMSmQT.key_idea: Adapt a text-to-audio-video generator with degraded audio-video conditioning via progressive caption-to-fixed-prompt annealing, then compress inference with one-step MeanFlow distillation.
5ufwDMSmQT.evidence: Supported by a residual-learning proof of reduced gradient variance and restoration risk, throughput tests at 1K and 2K on one GPU, and evaluation on OmniVRBench.
5ufwDMSmQT.claimed_gains: OmniVR-Flash achieves 38.2 fps at 1K resolution and 17.8 fps at 2K resolution on a single GPU.

CFrueKW9JQ.one_liner: Canonical hand-field unification and multi-view EMA teacher distillation predict dense bimanual tactile contact from egocentric video alone.
CFrueKW9JQ.problem: Egocentric human-object interaction videos lack dense contact and pressure annotations because occlusions hide hand-object contact surfaces and tactile datasets span incompatible embodiments.
CFrueKW9JQ.method: TouchAnnotator maps glove pressure, geometry-derived human contact, and robot fingertip deformation into a unified canonical hand field with source-aware validity masks. An EMA teacher observing synchronized egocentric and wrist views distills hand-local features and tactile predictions into an ego-video-plus-pose student equipped with past-clip memory.
CFrueKW9JQ.key_idea: Unify heterogeneous human and robot touch labels in a canonical hand field and distill wrist-plus-ego teacher representations into an egocentric-only student.
CFrueKW9JQ.evidence: Trained across six datasets and three embodiments, and evaluated on EgoTouch, zero-shot FPHA transfer, bare-hand qualitative transfer, and 860 synchronized tactile glove recordings.
CFrueKW9JQ.claimed_gains: On measured tactile recordings under a shared protocol, TouchAnnotator improves temporal accuracy by 5.38 points and Volumetric IoU by 5.02 points.

6hkbM1butb.one_liner: Robust frequent directions Hessian sketching reduces per-round estimation and exploration costs in high-dimensional multinomial logistic bandits.
6hkbM1butb.problem: UCB-style multinomial logistic bandit algorithms such as OFUL-MLogB incur O(K³d³) per-round time and O(K²d²) space, making them impractical for high-dimensional action spaces.
6hkbM1butb.method: EOFD-MLogB maintains a low-rank SVD sketch of the online Newton step Hessian using robust frequent directions of sketch size m ≪ d. This reduces constrained ONS parameter updates to one-dimensional root finding and reduces optimistic bonus spectral-norm evaluation from Kd×K to a K×K eigenvalue problem.
6hkbM1butb.key_idea: Maintain a rank-m robust frequent-directions sketch of the online Newton Hessian to reduce parameter updates to scalar root-finding and exploration bonuses to K×K eigenproblems.
6hkbM1butb.evidence: Supported by per-round time and space complexity derivations and a high-probability regret bound controlled by m-truncated Hessian tail error (empirical experiments truncated in the abstract).
