6hkbM1butb.claimed_gains: EOFD-MLogB reduces per-round complexity from O(K³d³) time and O(K²d²) space to O(Kd(m+K)²) time and O(Kd(m+K)) space with regret Õ(Δ_T(Kd ln Δ_T + m)√T).

AbstEvyxI3.one_liner: Allocates multiresolution hash capacity by maximizing information retrievable after collisions rather than using uniform layouts.
AbstEvyxI3.problem: Data-agnostic hash layouts uniformly allocate capacity despite spatially and spectrally varying signal information, wasting parameters and causing dense-region collisions.
AbstEvyxI3.method: RIM formulates layout selection as Retrievable Information Maximization for a fixed hash-table size. RIM-Hash routes low-information blocks to lightweight fallback features and concentrates hash capacity where information is present and recoverable.
AbstEvyxI3.key_idea: Choose hash resolutions and spatial routing to maximize post-collision retrievable information, assigning fallback features to low-information blocks.
AbstEvyxI3.evidence: Experiments on 2D images and 3D signed-distance fields compare parameter-fidelity trade-offs against strong hash-grid baselines.
AbstEvyxI3.claimed_gains: On Tokyo, RIM-Hash uses only 11.43% of the prior method’s parameters at comparable fidelity, while on Girl it improves PSNR by 12.43 dB at comparable scale.

zraqHQNItR.one_liner: Fuses trainable rank-1 block screening into IO-aware attention kernels for dynamic sparse training and decoding.
zraqHQNItR.problem: Dynamic sparse attention only yields GPU speedups when block-selection overhead and memory traffic remain low.
zraqHQNItR.method: DMA derives cheap blockwise gate-score bounds from a rank-1 query-key gate and skips QK and post-score work on screened tiles. Screening is fused into forward, backward, and decoding kernels without a dense routing matrix, while the gate modulates retained logits and trains end to end.
zraqHQNItR.key_idea: Use rank-1 query-key bounds to screen attention blocks directly inside IO-aware kernels and train the same gate to modulate retained logits.
zraqHQNItR.evidence: Experiments span 80M to 8B models across pretraining, long-context evaluation, and sparse adaptation, including Qwen3-8B quality and serving-throughput measurements.
zraqHQNItR.claimed_gains: On Qwen3-8B, DMA scores 64.26 versus 62.50 for Full Attention and delivers approximately 1.2× prefill and decode serving throughput under an 8K-input/24K-output workload.

UMC5Pox5IC.one_liner: Jointly denoises motion and inter-joint distances with one-way relational guidance for text-to-motion diffusion.
UMC5Pox5IC.problem: Text-to-motion generators leave inter-joint relations implicit or use distances only as losses and guidance rather than explicit denoising state.
UMC5Pox5IC.method: AMDD uses a two-stream denoiser for motion and sparse continuous inter-joint distances. The distance stream is shielded from noisy motion and guides it one way, with geometric consistency and a text-conditioned gate regulating updates.
UMC5Pox5IC.key_idea: Maintain inter-joint distances as an explicit denoising state that guides motion asymmetrically without receiving noisy-motion corruption.
UMC5Pox5IC.evidence: Experiments span three HumanML3D diffusion backbones and SnapMoGen, measuring FID, inter-joint distance error, and position error.
UMC5Pox5IC.claimed_gains: AMDD lowers FID by 43–84% on HumanML3D across three diffusion backbones and by 12% on SnapMoGen.

0GS7zi9wXp.one_liner: Introduces the MVSign multi-view sign language benchmark and CanonSLU using frontal-view knowledge transfer and motion aggregation.
0GS7zi9wXp.problem: Existing sign language understanding methods assume fixed frontal views and fail under viewpoint changes due to scarce multi-view training data.
0GS7zi9wXp.method: The authors build MVSign across three sign languages and seven viewpoints by synthesizing views via 3D whole-body motion reconstruction, and propose CanonSLU combining Canonical-View Knowledge Transfer from the frontal anchor with Motion Relation Aggregation.
0GS7zi9wXp.key_idea: Transfers canonical representations from a frontal-view anchor to non-frontal views via CKT while aggregating cross-frame motion relations.
0GS7zi9wXp.evidence: Experiments on the constructed MVSign benchmark spanning three sign languages and seven viewpoints.

OQjrpD7Gdp.one_liner: Adapts spiking neural network surrogate gradient ranges dynamically using decision-weighted perturbation-induced spike flips.
OQjrpD7Gdp.problem: Fixed surrogate gradient profiles in spiking neural networks misallocate backward sensitivity away from membrane states involved in adversarial spike flips.
OQjrpD7Gdp.method: FARE derives dynamic surrogate response ranges from decision-weighted spike flips under perturbation, reallocating backward gradients toward decision-relevant membrane dynamics.
OQjrpD7Gdp.key_idea: Dynamically shapes surrogate gradient response ranges based on decision-weighted spike flips caused by adversarial perturbations.
OQjrpD7Gdp.evidence: Experiments across static, sequential, event-based, and large-scale spiking neural network tasks.

sHf7fyHb7q.one_liner: Forecasts the consumption-time learner policy at rollout dispatch using a consistency-constrained multi-lag parameter predictor.
sHf7fyHb7q.problem: Asynchronous RL post-training suffers from policy staleness because rollouts are generated by a behavior policy lagging behind the updated learner.
sHf7fyHb7q.method: FARL extrapolates the learner's next parameter displacement from recent updates via a consistency-constrained multi-lag predictor and dispatches rollouts from this frozen forecasted policy.
sHf7fyHb7q.key_idea: Extrapolates one-step-ahead learner parameters at rollout dispatch using a consistency-constrained multi-lag predictor to cancel first-order policy lag.
sHf7fyHb7q.evidence: Theoretical error and importance-weight variance bounds under fixed-step smooth learner dynamics.
sHf7fyHb7q.claimed_gains: Reduces asymptotic forecast residual upper bound from O(eta) for stale generation to O(eta^2).

LC1uNInJR0.one_liner: Scores brain-to-language retrieval at the text decoder input with duration and local-evidence controls to isolate neural signal.
LC1uNInJR0.problem: End-to-end MEG/EEG sentence decoding scores can be inflated by input duration padding, decoder language priors, or text metrics rather than brain signal.
LC1uNInJR0.method: The authors propose source attribution, evaluating retrieval accuracy at the decoder input and decomposing contributions into input structure, within-window evidence, and cross-window context using duration-matched noise and local-evidence controls.
LC1uNInJR0.key_idea: Evaluates neural decoding at the text decoder input via retrieval accuracy with duration-matched noise and local-evidence ablations to separate brain signal from shortcuts.
LC1uNInJR0.evidence: Analyses on an end-to-end MEG sentence decoding pipeline (1,464 candidates) and comparison with an invasive ECoG control.
LC1uNInJR0.claimed_gains: Duration-matched Gaussian noise retains 66.3% sentence-retrieval R@1 vs 90.8% for MEG; with fixed durations, word-locked MEG windows identify their audio among 1,464 candidates for 44% of windows while noise stays at chance.

NAkoYPPfwX.one_liner: Automates conversion of paper-repository pairs into 30 protected, executable scientific environments via SciEnBuilder for coding agents.
NAkoYPPfwX.problem: Raw code repositories often permit shortcut behaviors or unreliable evaluation when used as environments for automated scientific discovery by coding agents.
NAkoYPPfwX.method: The authors study how environmental feedback shapes coding-agent exploration across four agents and four feedback settings, then introduce SciEnBuilder to automatically transform paper-repository pairs into 30 scientific environments linking claims, executable evidence, and protected evaluation.
NAkoYPPfwX.key_idea: Connecting paper claims to executable evidence and protected evaluation turns raw repositories into shortcut-resistant scientific environments.
NAkoYPPfwX.evidence: Controlled studies with four coding agents across four feedback settings and human evaluation of 30 SciEnBuilder environments.

Rgvz8ANZnD.one_liner: Trains unified multimodal models via a two-stage RLVR and RLMT loop on 300 samples to self-evaluate and reprompt generation.
Rgvz8ANZnD.problem: Unified multimodal models exhibit strong visual understanding that fails to guide their own image generation process.
Rgvz8ANZnD.method: They propose Endogenous Reprompting and the SEER two-stage framework using 300 Visual Instruction Elaboration samples. Stage one uses Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) to activate latent evaluation ability into an endogenous reward, and stage two uses Reinforcement Learning with Model-rewarded Thinking (RLMT) to optimize generative reasoning descriptors.
Rgvz8ANZnD.key_idea: Uses a two-stage RLVR-then-RLMT loop on 300 proxy samples to turn a unified model's understanding into self-rewarded generative reprompting.
Rgvz8ANZnD.evidence: Evaluated on evaluation accuracy, reprompting efficiency, generation quality, and general multimodal capabilities against baseline models.

egu7sWhE68.one_liner: Trains an RL agent to localize and repair defects in structured knowledge bases using query-driven execution feedback.
egu7sWhE68.problem: External knowledge bases suffer from incompleteness, errors, and redundancy that degrade RAG without affordable full-KB reconstruction.
egu7sWhE68.method: DeepRefine localizes defective KB regions via multi-turn interaction and error abduction, applies persistent insert/delete/replace edits, and optimizes the refinement policy end-to-end with a Gain-Beyond-Draft reward.
egu7sWhE68.key_idea: Uses agentic RL with a Gain-Beyond-Draft reward to perform query-driven insert, delete, and replace repairs on structured knowledge bases.
egu7sWhE68.evidence: Experiments across five benchmarks, three KB constructors, and four retrievers.

a70W2l4Lxx.one_liner: Removes latent-domain diffusion watermarks by replacing high-scale visual autoregressive tokens while preserving low-scale semantic tokens.
a70W2l4Lxx.problem: Diffusion regeneration attacks fail to remove latent-domain image watermarks because they preserve generation-inversion symmetry.
a70W2l4Lxx.method: Visual Autoregressive Regeneration (VARR) quantizes watermarked images into multi-scale VAR tokens, retains low-scale semantic tokens, replaces high-scale tokens with VAR transformer predictions, and reconstructs the image.
a70W2l4Lxx.key_idea: Breaks diffusion generation-inversion symmetry by retaining coarse VAR semantic tokens while regenerating fine-scale tokens autoregressively.
a70W2l4Lxx.evidence: Evaluations across eight latent-domain watermarking methods measuring removal success rate and FID against pixel, frequency, and diffusion regeneration baselines.
a70W2l4Lxx.claimed_gains: VARR achieves an average removal success rate of 92.8% with an average FID of 28.27 across eight latent-domain watermarks, versus FIDs of 40 to 75 for regeneration baselines.

r8wTnGVYe7.one_liner: Uses a gradient-energy probe to place a single LoRA adapter at the dominant shallow FFN down-projection layer.
r8wTnGVYe7.problem: Standard LoRA distributes adapters broadly across layers, leaving optimal single- or few-adapter placement largely unexplored.
r8wTnGVYe7.method: The authors propose PAGE to measure initial trainable gradient energy per candidate module, finding concentration at one shallow FFN down-projection, and introduce DomLoRA to place a single LoRA adapter at that dominant module.
r8wTnGVYe7.key_idea: Identifies a single task-stable dominant shallow FFN down-projection via projected gradient energy and places one LoRA adapter there.
r8wTnGVYe7.evidence: Experiments across two model families and four downstream tasks covering instruction following, math reasoning, coding, and multi-turn conversation.
r8wTnGVYe7.claimed_gains: With 0.7% of vanilla LoRA's trainable parameters, DomLoRA outperforms it on average across downstream tasks and reduces training time by up to 2.74x.

gbh9RICpAD.one_liner: Derives an excess-risk bound via local Rademacher complexity and adjusts SAM parameter perturbations using sample-wise classification margins.
gbh9RICpAD.problem: Loss sharpness alone does not reliably explain model generalization, as empirical studies report weak or opposite correlations.
gbh9RICpAD.method: The authors derive a local Rademacher complexity excess-risk bound showing generalization depends jointly on sharpness and margin-dependent complexity, and propose Rad, a plug-in that scales SAM perturbations according to sample-wise classification margins.
gbh9RICpAD.key_idea: Adjusts SAM parameter perturbation directions using sample-wise classification margins derived from a local Rademacher complexity excess-risk bound.
gbh9RICpAD.evidence: Theoretical excess-risk bound and experiments combining Rad with SAM and its variants across multiple datasets and model architectures.

g64G7Iv44I.one_liner: Attacks generative recommenders by appending suffixes to item descriptions to flip discrete Semantic IDs using surrogate text encoders.
g64G7Iv44I.problem: Discrete Semantic IDs (SIDs) in generative recommendation create a black-box attack surface where minor listing edits can alter item codes for promotion.
g64G7Iv44I.method: SIDAttack appends short suffixes to target item descriptions using gradients from available text encoders and public-item anchors without victim feedback, and the authors propose margin-regularized codebook construction as a defense.
g64G7Iv44I.key_idea: Optimizes description suffixes against surrogate text encoders and public-item anchors to flip Semantic IDs, countered by margin-regularized codebooks.
g64G7Iv44I.evidence: Experiments across product, news, and short-video catalogs with two SID tokenizers under matched and held-out victim encoders.

g4NoYpuCfQ.one_liner: Trains a Decision Transformer with token-level uncertainty routing to transfer corruption robustness to temporally correlated attacks.
g4NoYpuCfQ.problem: Offline RL methods trained under temporally independent data corruption lack understood robustness transfer when tested under unseen, temporally correlated corruption.
g4NoYpuCfQ.method: UDT learns a token-level uncertainty signal to regulate causal information routing and downweight unreliable training targets in a Decision Transformer. The authors also introduce Drift-Attack, which creates temporally correlated test perturbations via burst-recover dynamics and momentum-driven drift.
g4NoYpuCfQ.key_idea: Learns token-level uncertainty to regulate both causal information routing and target training influence within a Decision Transformer.
g4NoYpuCfQ.evidence: Evaluations on nine D4RL tasks against seven baselines under Drift-Attack observation, action, and reward corruptions.
g4NoYpuCfQ.claimed_gains: UDT achieves the highest overall normalized score of 63.52 and ranks first on 11 out of 15 aggregate evaluation metrics.

iF2vU9ddak.one_liner: Endpoint differential and multi-split geodesic constraints align one-step Riemannian flow maps with manifold geometry.
iF2vU9ddak.problem: Under curvature, Euclidean relationships among average velocity, endpoint displacement, and generation error no longer hold for Riemannian MeanFlow.
iF2vU9ddak.method: RMF-BSC combines endpoint differential consistency with multi-split geodesic semigroup consistency. The paper also derives barycentric stability bounds and a variance-reduction result for multi-split averaging.
iF2vU9ddak.key_idea: Align average-velocity learning with endpoint log-displacements and geodesic composition rather than parallel-transported Euclidean-style averages.
iF2vU9ddak.evidence: Theoretical analysis identifies two geometric gaps and proves stability and variance-reduction results, while experiments test one-step generation on four manifold benchmarks.

dg1qvTJPKe.one_liner: Locally validated immutable specialists reuse chip-placement expertise without retraining or overwriting earlier adaptations.
dg1qvTJPKe.problem: Fine-tuning one macro-placement policy on unfamiliar circuits can overwrite earlier improvements, while saved checkpoints lack reliable reuse criteria.
dg1qvTJPKe.method: CARVE maintains a frozen base policy, immutable specialists, and task-specific credentials obtained through local validation. It reuses a qualifying specialist first and trains a new one from the frozen base only when none qualifies.
dg1qvTJPKe.key_idea: Gate reuse of immutable specialist policies with task-specific local validation credentials before considering new adaptation.
dg1qvTJPKe.evidence: Macro-placement follow-up and simulated receiving-deployment studies test IBM circuits and HPWL, complemented by navigation studies of repair retention.
dg1qvTJPKe.claimed_gains: A reuse-first follow-up reduces recorded training time by 58.5% (9.66 to 4.01 hours), while mean HPWL gain changes only from 8.41% to 7.86%; imported specialists achieve a 5.76% mean HPWL gain.

CjdhxVYNCp.one_liner: A visual plan and frame-aligned speech units coordinate text, personalized audio, and reference-conditioned avatar video.
CjdhxVYNCp.problem: Omni-modal dialogue models can produce spoken replies but leave the responding agent without a visual presence.
CjdhxVYNCp.method: Ex-Omni-2D generates a Visual Thought Plan and response text, then produces multi-codebook speech units aligned with video frames. A full-sequence generator conditions on reference appearance, plan semantics, and speech units, with a block-causal streaming variant for lower startup latency.
CjdhxVYNCp.key_idea: Use frame-aligned speech units as a common timing signal between personalized audio and reference-conditioned video generation.
CjdhxVYNCp.evidence: The supplied abstract describes a main quality evaluation and streaming-latency comparison but names no datasets or numerical results.

Y5bMFgPFlM.one_liner: Language-encoded actions let one latent future predictor train across simulation, robot, image, and video data.
Y5bMFgPFlM.problem: Latent world models trained separately for each domain or task cannot easily share heterogeneous action representations and data sources.
Y5bMFgPFlM.method: LaLa-World expresses numerical actions and visual changes in natural language and builds a JEPA-style future predictor on a language model. The pretrained model supports model-predictive-control planning and initialization for LaLa-Policy.
Y5bMFgPFlM.key_idea: Encode actions and visual changes as language conditions so one language-model-based predictor learns future latent states across heterogeneous data.
Y5bMFgPFlM.evidence: Planning comparisons cover simulation and robot trajectories, added image and video data, separately trained LWMs, and an RAEv2-based video generation baseline.
Y5bMFgPFlM.claimed_gains: Against an RAEv2-based video generation baseline, LaLa-World reaches comparable planning performance with 6× less training cost and up to 13.9× faster planning.

0RtZqcyXtK.one_liner: Extracts training-free multi-scale local differences along frozen generative latent trajectories to detect and localize forged video intervals.
0RtZqcyXtK.problem: Frame-level discriminative detectors overlook temporal evolution cues needed to localize short AI-generated intervals inserted into real videos.
0RtZqcyXtK.method: DELTA extracts multi-scale descriptors of local transitions along latent trajectories from a frozen generative encoder without fine-tuning, feeding them to supervised detection and localization heads. For full-video detection, it maps continuous spatial transitions to discrete patterns, and the authors introduce a paired-source partial-forgery localization benchmark.
0RtZqcyXtK.key_idea: Models multi-scale local transition differences along frozen generative encoder latent trajectories instead of isolated frame embeddings.
0RtZqcyXtK.evidence: Evaluated on temporal partial-forgery localization (including unseen-generator tests with an ActionFormer localizer) and full-video detection.
0RtZqcyXtK.claimed_gains: Replacing CLIP features with DELTA under ActionFormer on unseen-generator evaluation improves mean AP from 77.68 to 86.31.

iERgCe4T6R.one_liner: Equips multimodal agents with visual acquisition and pruning tools plus two-stage SFT-RL for long-horizon image exploration.
iERgCe4T6R.problem: Multimodal active-perception agents hit context limits during extended multi-turn image exploration because accumulated visual observations grow rapidly.
iERgCe4T6R.method: ThymeV2 pairs multi-turn visual exploration with an evolving visual memory using tools that acquire multi-region image views and discard unneeded observations. It is trained via turn-level SFT followed by RL combining outcome and process signals, and evaluated on a new 893-item benchmark, StratBenchFinal.
iERgCe4T6R.key_idea: Combines multi-region image acquisition and observation-removal tools with turn-level SFT and outcome-plus-process RL for bounded-context exploration.
iERgCe4T6R.evidence: Constructed a multi-turn exploration dataset and introduced StratBenchFinal (893 examples) for evaluating sustained active visual perception.

QnCOGVyEWv.one_liner: Trains a Beta-Binomial process reward model to predict step success and reliability for adaptive Best-of-N allocation.
QnCOGVyEWv.problem: Standard Process Reward Models output only a point score per reasoning step, leaving downstream search unable to distinguish trustworthy rewards from uncertain predictions.
QnCOGVyEWv.method: BetaPRM predicts a Beta distribution over step success probability trained via a Beta-Binomial likelihood on Monte Carlo continuation counts. Its Adaptive Computation Allocation (ACA) uses the learned reliability to stop early on reliable high-reward solutions and allocate extra compute to uncertain prefixes.
QnCOGVyEWv.key_idea: Fits a Beta belief per reasoning step via Beta-Binomial likelihood on Monte Carlo rollouts to quantify reward reliability for adaptive test-time allocation.
QnCOGVyEWv.evidence: Evaluated across four backbones and four reasoning benchmarks on PRM-guided Best-of-N selection and step-level error detection.

CuLrXbR9OQ.one_liner: Couples video restoration and sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting through bidirectional optical-flow distillation and guidance.
CuLrXbR9OQ.problem: Sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting suffers from Geometry Cheating where appearance hides depth errors, while video-diffusion completions provide only RGB supervision without explicit geometric constraints.
CuLrXbR9OQ.method: Bi-FlowGS alternates Video-to-Geometry Flow Distillation (V2G), which distills temporal correspondence priors from restored videos into Gaussian geometry, with Geometry-to-Video Flow-Guided Restoration (G2V), which uses current 3DGS geometry to guide temporally consistent video restoration.
CuLrXbR9OQ.key_idea: Iteratively couples optical-flow distillation from restored videos into 3DGS geometry with 3DGS geometry-guided flow restoration of unseen views.
CuLrXbR9OQ.evidence: Evaluated on wide-baseline and unbounded 360-degree sparse-view 3D reconstruction benchmarks.

0LG9X3THaC.one_liner: Tracks result provenance and dependent decisions in computer-use agents to resume waiting tasks and revise stale outcomes.
0LG9X3THaC.problem: Long-horizon computer-use agents suffer from Result-Work Desynchronization, leaving tasks unfinished after requested results arrive and failing to revise earlier decisions when results change.
0LG9X3THaC.method: Demand-Linked Execution (DLE) records why each intermediate result was requested and which decisions and artifacts depend on its adopted version. When results arrive or change, the agent uses these dependency records and current software observations to resume waiting work and selectively retain or revise affected outcomes.
0LG9X3THaC.key_idea: Logs request reasons and versioned decision/artifact dependencies so arriving or updated results trigger targeted task resumption and outcome revision.
0LG9X3THaC.evidence: Evaluated on OSWorld 2.0 (desktop), Odysseys (web), and MobileWorld (mobile), plus controlled probes against explicit-use and persistent task-graph baselines.
0LG9X3THaC.claimed_gains: DLE improves task success over Vanilla by 6.5 percentage points on OSWorld 2.0, 9.0 percentage points on Odysseys, and 10.9 percentage points on MobileWorld.

NCQE87iRdM.one_liner: Recovers unobserved UAV-ground geo-localization relations by aligning disjoint UAV-satellite and satellite-ground pairs via shared Geo-primitives.
NCQE87iRdM.problem: Pairwise geo-localization training on disjoint UAV-satellite and satellite-ground datasets fails to recover the unobserved UAV-ground relation because separate objectives lack cross-edge comparability.
NCQE87iRdM.method: GeoCoRe is a two-stage framework for incomplete tri-view geo-localization. Stage 1 induces shared Geo-primitives as a common reference, and Stage 2 uses them to guide coordinate assignment and align shared-coordinate representations across both observed view pairs.
NCQE87iRdM.key_idea: Induces shared Geo-primitives in Stage 1 to anchor coordinate assignment and align representations across disjoint UAV-satellite and satellite-ground pairs in Stage 2.
NCQE87iRdM.evidence: Evaluated on incomplete tri-view geo-localization recovering unobserved UAV-ground relations from disjoint pairwise supervision.

VD3ZSgPajK.one_liner: Induces self-validated user-specific evaluation rubrics from interaction histories using discriminative RL against personalized model outputs.
VD3ZSgPajK.problem: Automatic metrics and static LLM-as-a-judge evaluators fail to capture subjective, user-specific preferences embedded in long-term interaction histories.
VD3ZSgPajK.method: PARL (Preference-Aware Rubric Learning) induces preference-aware evaluation rubrics directly from raw user histories and applies a self-validation mechanism for user consistency. It trains rubric induction with a discriminative RL objective contrasting user-authored responses against competitive personalized model outputs.
VD3ZSgPajK.key_idea: Trains user-history rubric induction via discriminative RL contrasting user-authored and personalized model responses, paired with self-validation for user consistency.
VD3ZSgPajK.evidence: Evaluated on real-world personalized text generation tasks.

PUShAYSKyx.one_liner: Regularizes VLA policies with lineage-matched pre-action VLM and source VLA anchors to preserve control under dense instructions.
PUShAYSKyx.problem: VLA models trained on concise commands suffer a sharp Sparse-Dense Gap when given richer task-equivalent instructions, and action fine-tuning erodes inherited visual-language capability.
PUShAYSKyx.method: The authors build a three-level task-equivalent dense-language benchmark for matched rollouts and propose STAR (Sparse-to-dense Task Alignment Regularization). STAR regularizes adaptation using a lineage-matched pre-action VLM as a representation anchor and the source VLA as an action anchor.
PUShAYSKyx.key_idea: Pairs a lineage-matched pre-action VLM representation anchor with a source VLA action anchor during adaptation to preserve dense-language grounding.
PUShAYSKyx.evidence: Audited and evaluated on LIBERO and SimplerEnv using matched rollouts across three levels of dense task-equivalent instructions.
PUShAYSKyx.claimed_gains: Across LIBERO, STAR raises dense macro success from 7.2% to 24.3% while retaining 69.7% sparse success.

D9h8Rr3ys0.one_liner: Meta-learns abstract task-state schemas and DAG procedural memory with historical reprojection for adaptive test-time task decomposition.
D9h8Rr3ys0.problem: Language agents storing past procedures struggle in long-horizon tasks to determine which stored procedures apply and what subgoals remain as execution unfolds.
D9h8Rr3ys0.method: MetaDecomp uses an outer in-context meta-learning loop to build abstract task-relative states and DAG procedures from training trajectories, revisiting past executions to reproject state assignments as new distinctions emerge. At test time with fixed memory, an inner loop combines retrieved procedure fragments with task-specific steps and revises decompositions from environment feedback.
D9h8Rr3ys0.key_idea: Jointly evolves abstract state schemas and DAG procedural memory via historical execution reprojection, then adapts retrieved fragments with environment feedback at test time.
D9h8Rr3ys0.evidence: Evaluated over three seeds on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld (five settings total, including Qwen3-4B) against ReAct, AutoRefine, and component ablations.
D9h8Rr3ys0.claimed_gains: MetaDecomp achieves the highest mean performance in four of five settings, including 86.3% success on ALFWorld with Qwen3-4B, while using fewer inference tokens than ReAct and AutoRefine in all five settings.

lvjmQ5NdHY.one_liner: Introduces a multi-turn dialogue dataset spanning seven risk domains and 58 response strategies for personalized safety alignment.
lvjmQ5NdHY.problem: Uniform LLM safety alignment either gives harmful advice to vulnerable individuals or over-accommodates user personas in ways that bypass general safety boundaries.
lvjmQ5NdHY.method: The authors construct MDPSA, a multi-turn dialogue dataset for personalized safety alignment covering seven high-risk domains and 58 fine-grained response strategies that capture evolving user emotional states and context-driven jailbreaks, and train LLMs on it across post-training paradigms.
lvjmQ5NdHY.key_idea: Supervises personalized multi-turn safety alignment with 58 fine-grained response strategies across seven risk domains capturing emotional shifts and contextual jailbreaks.
lvjmQ5NdHY.evidence: Empirical experiments across multiple post-training and alignment paradigms comparing standard and MDPSA-trained models.

9MJtBrLVn8.one_liner: Analyzes Muon as an accumulation-free Kronecker curvature approximation replacing input factors with momentum Gram and output factors with identity.
9MJtBrLVn8.problem: While algebraically linked to accumulation-free Shampoo, it is unclear whether Muon's orthogonalized momentum actually tracks the layer curvature of trained neural networks.
9MJtBrLVn8.method: The authors model Muon as an accumulation-free Kronecker-factored curvature approximation using the current momentum Gram as the input factor and identity as the output factor, and introduce a signal-and-noise decomposition separating subspace recovery from spectral accuracy.
9MJtBrLVn8.key_idea: Decomposes Muon's momentum Gram into signal and noise to evaluate when it recovers leading curvature subspaces and where replacing the output factor with identity fails.
9MJtBrLVn8.evidence: Measured against a sequence-level generalized Gauss-Newton reference in GPT-2 plus controlled quadratic and nonlinear experiments.

LjT2Bez1xh.one_liner: Distills bidirectional action-conditioned video generators into 1-, 2-, and 4-step causal world models via four progressive training stages.
LjT2Bez1xh.problem: Extending few-step causal video distillation to interactive world models is difficult because discrete keyboard and continuous mouse controls must stay aligned with temporally compressed latent chunks.
LjT2Bez1xh.method: ForgeWM converts a bidirectional action-conditioned video generator into budget-specialized 1-, 2-, and 4-step causal world models via domain adaptation, teacher-forced causal training, causal consistency distillation, and on-policy distribution matching against a bidirectional teacher. A dual-path protocol lets the one-step student re-noise and refine saved drafts offline.
LjT2Bez1xh.key_idea: Progressively distills a bidirectional video generator through causal teacher-forcing, consistency distillation, and on-policy distribution matching, with optional one-step re-noise replay refinement.
LjT2Bez1xh.evidence: Evaluated on paired Minecraft trajectories against alternative post-training baselines on the same backbone, plus transfer to gamepad-controlled FPS gameplay.

IrnmNGDuiH.one_liner: Selectively replays image tokens at test time by maximizing submodular marginal repayment of visual demand-support mismatch.
IrnmNGDuiH.problem: Existing test-time visual refocusing replays image tokens by current relevance without checking whether realized visual support already satisfies the reasoning step's visual demand.
IrnmNGDuiH.method: The authors define Visual Evidence Debt as one minus the probability-mass overlap between visual demand and realized visual support, whose positive residual pinpoints under-supported image tokens. EvidenceFlow is a training-free method that selects tokens under a replay budget by optimizing a saturating monotone submodular marginal debt-repayment objective.
IrnmNGDuiH.key_idea: Quantifies Visual Evidence Debt from demand-versus-support distribution overlap and selects replayed image tokens via a budgeted saturating monotone submodular objective.
IrnmNGDuiH.evidence: Evaluated across multiple MLLMs and multimodal reasoning benchmarks against standard thinking and visual replay baselines.

NMtvVi3jjm.one_liner: Generates continuous collision-free UAV trajectories from language and 3D observations using flow-matching transport over a semantic-geometric field.
NMtvVi3jjm.problem: Discrete waypoint prediction in language-conditioned aerial navigation ignores intermediate states governing collision risk, dynamic smoothness, and semantic progress.
NMtvVi3jjm.method: CSNF encodes language, RGB-D/LiDAR observations, and vehicle state into a continuous semantic-geometric navigation field and uses a flow-matching transport model to evolve noise into feasible trajectories under differentiable occupancy, instruction-alignment, and uncertainty constraints, trained with an intermediate-to-future consistency objective.
NMtvVi3jjm.key_idea: Transports noise trajectories via flow matching over a multimodal semantic-geometric field while differentiably enforcing occupancy, instruction, and uncertainty constraints.
NMtvVi3jjm.evidence: Theoretical discretization-bias proof under local regularity, simulation evaluation on VLN-CE, Habitat-Matterport3D, and AirSim-style UAV scenes, and real-world UAV flight experiments.

Pn9UfE5GYL.one_liner: Uses collaborative agents to evolve verifiable VQA-probe evaluation protocols calibrated on four images for open-ended image quality assessment.
Pn9UfE5GYL.problem: Image quality assessment models rely on fixed definitions and exhibit holistic bias on unseen perceptual dimensions, reusing generic quality priors and causing rank inversion.
Pn9UfE5GYL.method: PACE is a training-free multi-agent framework that constructs explicit evaluation protocols of verifiable VQA probes for any target perceptual dimension. It calibrates the protocol with four human-annotated images per dimension and aligns MLLM perceptions to human scales via a dual-track scoring mechanism.
Pn9UfE5GYL.key_idea: Replaces holistic MLLM scoring with collaborative-agent-constructed verifiable VQA-probe protocols calibrated on four labeled images and a dual-track human-scale alignment mechanism.
Pn9UfE5GYL.evidence: Evaluated across traditional IQA, structural fidelity, context-aware aesthetics, and newly defined open-ended perceptual dimensions on MLLM backbones.
Pn9UfE5GYL.claimed_gains: Reduces the Holistic Override Rate (HOR) from 44.4% to 8.6% while consistently improving its MLLM backbone across IQA settings.

mOTHJE79Be.one_liner: Benchmarks ten synthetic-image detectors on 795 fake-looking real photographs and mitigates false positives via hard-negative probe retraining.
mOTHJE79Be.problem: AI-generated image detectors are evaluated mainly on typical real photos, hiding severe false-positive failures on genuine photographs that appear visually anomalous.
mOTHJE79Be.method: The authors curate FLORIDA, a dataset of 795 fake-looking real photographs organized into a nine-way taxonomy, and evaluate ten detectors across six families alongside a provenance-matched control. They test failure correlation across detectors, analyze frequency-space atypicality, and retrain a linear probe using 396 fake-looking real photos as hard negatives.
mOTHJE79Be.key_idea: Audits synthetic-image detectors with provenance-matched controls on 795 curated fake-looking real photographs and shows hard-negative linear-probe retraining largely eliminates false positives.
mOTHJE79Be.evidence: Evaluates ten detectors across six families on 795 FLORIDA photographs and provenance-matched controls, plus linear-probe retraining with 396 hard-negative real images.
mOTHJE79Be.claimed_gains: Six of seven passing detectors flag FLORIDA at 1.8x–33x their control FPR (up to 80%, all p < 1e-4; up to 5.5x after provenance matching), failures are nearly independent (median phi = 0.04, 95.5% fool at least one detector), and retraining cuts linear-probe FPR from 55.9% to 1.0%.

FX1zPakTc4.one_liner: Selects adverse-condition generative augmentations for UAV detection via backward greedy coverage-redundancy optimization over frozen-detector features.
FX1zPakTc4.problem: Semantically distinct generative weather or lighting augmentations can induce redundant shifts in small-UAV detector features, making full-condition augmentation suboptimal.
FX1zPakTc4.method: The authors decouple background editing from source-UAV integration to reuse annotations under a shared target reference across conditions. A frozen clean-trained detector measures paired context-feature shifts, whose similarities guide backward greedy selection optimizing a coverage-redundancy objective.
FX1zPakTc4.key_idea: Measures paired context-feature shifts of a frozen clean-trained detector across decoupled background-edited UAV images and selects non-redundant adverse conditions via backward greedy coverage-redundancy optimization.
FX1zPakTc4.evidence: Evaluated with five candidate adverse conditions on RT-DETRv2-S and YOLO11m across 13 training seeds against Clean-only, uniform random subsets, and Full generation.
FX1zPakTc4.claimed_gains: Selected three-condition sets improve external mAP over Full generation by 1.29 AP points for RT-DETRv2-S and 0.74 points for YOLO11m across 13 seeds.

bBCcGh8rse.one_liner: Synthesizes TX-RX-conditioned RF spectra directly on the spherical manifold using deformable spherical Gaussians and a custom CUDA rasterizer.
bBCcGh8rse.problem: Existing Gaussian splatting methods for RF spectrum synthesis operate on planar projections that distort spherical geometry and ignore coupled variations from joint transmitter-receiver mobility.
bBCcGh8rse.method: SphGaS models RF spectra with spherical Gaussian primitives that deform according to the joint transmitter-receiver configuration. A customized CUDA rasterizer renders these primitives directly in the spherical domain to preserve response geometry while capturing coupled TX-RX movement.
bBCcGh8rse.key_idea: Deforms spherical Gaussian primitives as a function of joint TX-RX configuration and rasterizes them directly on the spherical manifold via a custom CUDA kernel.
bBCcGh8rse.evidence: Evaluated on real-world RFID datasets against existing Gaussian splatting methods for RF spectrum synthesis.
bBCcGh8rse.claimed_gains: Improves PSNR by 1.49 dB and achieves up to 40x faster rendering than compared GS-based methods on real-world RFID datasets.

xJcUIBSxEE.one_liner: Builds elastic selective spectral-attention hybrids that export multiple model sizes from one training run.
xJcUIBSxEE.problem: Elastic spectral state space models allow channel truncation for budgeted deployment, but linear time-invariant filters cannot selectively retain or forget context.
xJcUIBSxEE.method: Elastic Selective Spectral Hybrid (ESSH) turns each Hankel spectral channel into an independent recurrent unit with fitted damped rotation modes and input-dependent decay and write/read gates, paired with sliding-window attention. It jointly trains nested capacities via a two-rate channel/FFN capacity map with full-model distillation.
xJcUIBSxEE.key_idea: Adds input-dependent decay and read/write gates to independent Hankel spectral recurrent channels and trains nested sub-models via a two-rate capacity map.
xJcUIBSxEE.evidence: Single 1.53B-parameter training run exporting ten models from 0.47B to 1.53B parameters, evaluated on a seven-task accuracy suite.
xJcUIBSxEE.claimed_gains: A single 1.53B training run yields ten deployable models from 0.47B to 1.53B parameters, with full-model seven-task accuracy within 0.4-2.6 points of baselines (comparison target truncated in abstract).

2uHNt4sGpw.one_liner: Diagnoses referential under-specification in multimodal RAG trajectories and introduces the IIGCR trajectory intervention.
2uHNt4sGpw.problem: VLMs in agentic multimodal RAG emit under-specified entity references, leading to non-resolving retrievals and trajectory stagnation.
2uHNt4sGpw.method: The authors build a multi-dataset benchmark and define Retrieval-Involved Trajectory Efficiency (RTE) to measure evidence novelty and utility under oracle grounding and entity obfuscation. They also propose IIGCR, a model-agnostic trajectory intervention to improve accuracy, efficiency, and token usage.
2uHNt4sGpw.key_idea: Quantifies multimodal retrieval trajectory novelty and utility via RTE under referential definiteness modulation and applies a model-agnostic trajectory intervention (IIGCR).
2uHNt4sGpw.evidence: Multi-dataset benchmark across multiple VLM backbones, including Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct compared against MMSearch-R1-7B.

hxsJZCADTJ.one_liner: Distills SAM2 tracking motion priors into video diffusion via bidirectional feature fusion and Local Gram Flow loss.
hxsJZCADTJ.problem: Video diffusion models struggle to generate physically plausible, structure-preserving motion for articulated and deformable objects without noisy external flow or skeletons.
hxsJZCADTJ.method: SAM2VideoX distills motion priors from the autoregressive SAM2 tracker into bidirectional video diffusion models. It uses a bidirectional feature fusion module to extract global structural motion priors from SAM2 and a Local Gram Flow loss to align local feature co-movement.
hxsJZCADTJ.key_idea: Extracts bidirectional motion features from SAM2 and aligns local feature co-movement via a Local Gram Flow loss to distill structure-preserving motion into video diffusion.
hxsJZCADTJ.evidence: Evaluated on VBench and human preference studies against prior baselines including REPA.
hxsJZCADTJ.claimed_gains: Achieves 95.51% on VBench (+2.60 over REPA's 92.91%), 21-22% lower FVD (reducing FVD to 360.57, a 21.20% drop), and 71.4% human preference.

MeptIopX85.one_liner: Coordinates open multi-agent energy systems via decentralized knowledge sharing over a dynamic bipartite graph.
MeptIopX85.problem: Decentralized energy agents frequently join, leave, or shift behavior, making centralized-critic trajectory sharing infeasible and leaving new agents data-starved.
MeptIopX85.method: BISKY connects active agents to behavior channels through a dynamic bipartite graph without sharing raw observations, actions, or rewards. Each agent computes a compact local routing signature to attach to matching channels, which aggregate and return compact belief-adapter or policy updates.
MeptIopX85.key_idea: Routes decentralized agents by local behavior signatures to shared channels in a dynamic bipartite graph that aggregates belief-adapter or policy updates.
MeptIopX85.evidence: Evaluated in peer-to-peer energy trading (details truncated in abstract).

1Ykoi2y7zr.one_liner: Separates diagonal marginal normalization from global or localized spectral preconditioning for LLM matrix optimization.
1Ykoi2y7zr.problem: Matrix optimizers such as Muon process marginal-scale and interaction geometry jointly rather than separating their geometric roles.
1Ykoi2y7zr.method: NormPre implements a Normalize-Then-Precondition hierarchy that first normalizes updates with diagonal-Gram information and then applies spectral preconditioning to directional interactions. NormPre-G approximates global spectral preconditioning with Newton-Schulz iterations, while NormPre-L uses randomized sketching to precondition the leading interaction eigenspace.
1Ykoi2y7zr.key_idea: Applies diagonal-Gram marginal normalization before global Newton-Schulz or sketched localized spectral preconditioning of update interaction geometry.
1Ykoi2y7zr.evidence: O(T^-1/2) convergence proof for simplified variants and pretraining experiments on GPT-2 Small, LLaMA, and Qwen3 against AdamW, Muon, and MANO.

U0rmNv9uFo.one_liner: Constructs closed-form SFT target distributions that boost the demonstrated token while preserving student prior ratios.
U0rmNv9uFo.problem: One-hot supervised fine-tuning pushes probability onto the demonstrated token while distorting useful pretrained relative preferences needed for downstream RL.
U0rmNv9uFo.method: Peak-Preserving Prior Distillation (P3D / PPD) forms a closed-form dense target distribution directly from the current student without a teacher model or extra forward pass. Guided by Greedy Guarantee and Minimal Intervention, it makes the demonstrated token dominant while keeping relative probabilities among retained alternative tokens intact.
U0rmNv9uFo.key_idea: Replaces one-hot SFT labels with a closed-form student-derived target that guarantees demonstrated-token dominance while preserving relative probabilities among non-target tokens.
U0rmNv9uFo.evidence: Experiments across three models from two families on mathematical and medical reasoning, evaluated after SFT and subsequent GRPO against HardSFT.
U0rmNv9uFo.claimed_gains: Improves domain-averaged greedy accuracy over HardSFT by up to 6.1 percentage points after SFT and 10.3 points after GRPO.

UnQVghvXji.one_liner: Tests foundation model generalization by fine-tuning on counter-world rules and measuring cross-domain transfer.
UnQVghvXji.problem: Opaque pretraining corpora and data contamination make conventional out-of-distribution benchmarks unreliable for testing genuine generalization in large foundation models.
UnQVghvXji.method: Out-of-World Distribution (OOWD) defines counter-world input-output rules that contradict regular-world semantics, teaches them via limited source fine-tuning, and tests transfer to a different target input distribution under the same rules. The authors also run mechanistic analyses of layer and component causality.
UnQVghvXji.key_idea: Fine-tunes models on counter-world rules that conflict with pretraining knowledge and evaluates transfer of those rules to unseen target input domains.
UnQVghvXji.evidence: Evaluated across symbolic-to-verbal math, program-to-natural-language, cross-style visual, and text-to-image transfer, comparing large foundation models against small models trained from scratch.

ChJXF9h5lm.one_liner: Adds a lightweight refiner reusing flow-matching hidden states to predict per-step velocity residual corrections.
ChJXF9h5lm.problem: Flow-matching models discard intermediate hidden representations after predicting velocity at each step rather than reusing them to correct prediction errors.
ChJXF9h5lm.method: CorrFlow attaches a lightweight refiner that predicts velocity residual corrections from the base model's one-step clean prediction, conditioning, noise level, and hidden states from the same forward pass. Adding the correction before each sampling update requires no extra base-model evaluations.
ChJXF9h5lm.key_idea: Predicts per-step velocity residual corrections with a lightweight refiner using the base flow-matching model's same-pass hidden states and clean prediction.
ChJXF9h5lm.evidence: Theoretical analysis of feature reuse and compute-matched risk reduction, plus experiments on class-conditional image generation, text-to-video, and image-to-video generation.

S6Dmafpu1o.one_liner: Inserts nonlinear low-rank branches at Transformer block inputs to enable neuron-level residual stream mixing.
S6Dmafpu1o.problem: Multi-state residual designs mix whole hidden states or fixed coordinate partitions, leaving learnable neuron-level interactions within states underexplored.
S6Dmafpu1o.method: ResLorB (Residual Connections with Nonlinear Low-rank Branches) adds a lightweight nonlinear low-rank transformation at each Transformer block input to mix neurons within the residual stream. It composes with multi-state architectures such as mHC, where the low-rank branch can also act as an extra interactable state.
S6Dmafpu1o.key_idea: Adds a learnable nonlinear low-rank branch at block inputs to mix individual neurons in the residual stream and optionally interact with multi-state residuals.
S6Dmafpu1o.evidence: Pretraining experiments on DeepSeek-V3-style models scaling up to 3B/9B parameters.

CeYnTqMlWL.one_liner: Recycles retained VLM features and saved action proposals to accelerate flow-based VLA speculative inference.
CeYnTqMlWL.problem: Speculative inference for flow-based vision-language-action models discards prior speculative states on rejection or refresh, wasting computation and hurting action quality.
CeYnTqMlWL.method: Speculative State Recycling (SSR) reuses retained deep VLM features as semantic memory for a shallow predictor that also estimates draft-independent Context Risk to decide when to refresh conditioning. When refreshing, SSR initializes short fresh-conditioned Action Expert flow integration from saved proposals instead of noise.
CeYnTqMlWL.key_idea: Reuses cached VLM features for a shallow predictor and Context Risk gate, and warm-starts refreshed flow integration from saved action proposals.
CeYnTqMlWL.evidence: Evaluated on LIBERO with Triton (numerical results truncated in abstract).

fTjBsTcZIy.one_liner: Calibrates an unsigned distance field with ray-traced visibility supervision for differentiable light-independent visibility queries.
fTjBsTcZIy.problem: Ray tracing is costly for repeated visibility queries in inverse rendering, while shadow maps are light-dependent and not naturally differentiable with respect to light positions.
fTjBsTcZIy.method: Differentiable Shadow Fields (DSF) amortizes scene geometry into a shared scalar field initialized from an unsigned distance field and calibrated with ray-traced visibility supervision. Once built, it evaluates differentiable visibility along segments between surface points and arbitrary light endpoints without mesh intersection tests.
fTjBsTcZIy.key_idea: Calibrates an unsigned distance field and differentiable segment-query function with ray-traced visibility supervision for light-independent occlusion queries.
fTjBsTcZIy.evidence: Evaluated on visibility/shadow accuracy, query cost, shadow-driven light localization, inverse-rendering pipelines, and compositional scene editing.

nLbFtILl2j.one_liner: Introduces AneumoBench, a source-linked CFD benchmark of 401 source and 9,693 edited aneurysm geometries.
nLbFtILl2j.problem: Evaluating whether locally edited synthetic geometries improve physical-field surrogate prediction on unseen shapes requires controlled source-linked benchmarks.
nLbFtILl2j.method: AneumoBench links 401 source intracranial aneurysm geometries to 9,693 locally edited descendants with 80,752 steady velocity-pressure CFD cases and 9,715 100-frame transient velocity, pressure, and wall shear stress sequences. It provides mesh, point, and voxel interfaces with family-disjoint splits for comparing training regimes.
nLbFtILl2j.key_idea: Links 401 source aneurysm geometries to 9,693 edited descendants with steady and transient CFD fields to benchmark synthetic-geometry transfer under family-disjoint splits.
nLbFtILl2j.evidence: Evaluates nine architectures (including GraphSAGE) across source-only, descendant-only, and two-stage training on 79 held-out source geometries.

Nlff7tQRLM.one_liner: Applies asymmetric temporal pooling over decoder diagnostic-term probabilities to align radiology report generation.
Nlff7tQRLM.problem: Token-level maximum likelihood training for medical VLMs does not enforce asymmetric diagnostic requirements, causing omitted findings or unsupported differential diagnoses.
Nlff7tQRLM.method: Diagnostic Loss (DL) is an architecture-agnostic differentiable loss on decoder token probabilities for 2D and 3D MedVLMs. Using asymmetric temporal pooling, it requires supported diagnostic terms to achieve high probability at least once while suppressing probability spikes for unsupported diagnostic terms across the entire report.
Nlff7tQRLM.key_idea: Pools decoder probabilities asymmetrically over time to boost peak probability of supported diagnoses while suppressing unsupported diagnostic probability spikes across all positions.

SaSFlylZug.one_liner: Transfers unrestricted adversarial examples from CNNs to MLLMs via diffusion style injection and latent cross-attention attacks.
SaSFlylZug.problem: Directly backpropagating through MLLMs or running black-box API queries to craft adversarial examples is resource-intensive.
SaSFlylZug.method: StyleUAE generates unrestricted adversarial examples on small surrogate models by injecting non-common styles via a diffusion model to weaken MLLM recognition, then jointly attacking a CNN and diffusion cross-attention maps in latent space. Harmonized image priors and structure-preserving terms curb visual distortion.
SaSFlylZug.key_idea: Combines diffusion-based style injection with joint latent-space attacks on a surrogate CNN and diffusion cross-attention maps under structure-preserving priors.
SaSFlylZug.evidence: Evaluated against open-source MLLMs, commercial MLLMs, zero-shot vision-language models, and visual unimodal classifiers.
SaSFlylZug.claimed_gains: Achieves average ASRs (gains) of 77.5% (+45.8%), 80.9% (+56.7%), 77.2% (+21.4%), and 81.3% (+9.8%) on open-source MLLMs, commercial MLLMs, zero-shot VLMs, and visual unimodal classifiers.

LdiUXwvOPm.one_liner: Steers autoregressive video distillation by comparing teacher and history-grounded rollout feature deltas per chunk.
LdiUXwvOPm.problem: Streaming autoregressive video generators distilled from bidirectional diffusion teachers drift in identity, layout, and scene when interactive events switch due to teacher conditional bias.
LdiUXwvOPm.method: Delta Forcing modifies distribution-matching distillation with a transition-calibrated steering objective. For each generated chunk, it compares the feature-space delta of the teacher's denoised estimate against the generator's history-grounded rollout delta, keeping teacher distribution matching when they agree and shifting toward trajectory-continuity regularization when they diverge.
LdiUXwvOPm.key_idea: Compares teacher denoised feature deltas against student history-grounded rollout deltas per chunk to adaptively blend distribution matching with trajectory-continuity regularization.

EvfwKvcSHL.one_liner: Recovers conditional distributions from replicated group aggregates using pair spectra and bounded triple-phase features.
EvfwKvcSHL.problem: Disaggregating conditional response distributions from group totals fails when replicates share unknown offsets and heavy-tailed responses lack finite moments.
EvfwKvcSHL.method: Pair-Triple Spectral Recovery (PTSR) fits pair characteristic-function spectra to estimate distribution shape up to reflection, then uses bounded triple-phase features to select orientation while cancelling shared replicate offsets.
EvfwKvcSHL.key_idea: Estimates shape via pair spectra and resolves reflection ambiguity while cancelling unknown replicate offsets using bounded triple-phase features.
EvfwKvcSHL.evidence: Finite-sample local selection guarantees without raw-response moment assumptions, two synthetic alpha-stable mixture tasks (alpha=1.5), and measured power line communication voltages under constructed aggregates.

COPDovTggp.one_liner: Evolves executable coding-agent trajectory curation filters from pairwise LLM-judge disagreements without training.
COPDovTggp.problem: Filtering coding-agent SFT trajectories requires costly human-authored rules and repeated training runs because resolved runs can be noisy and failed runs can hold useful steps.
COPDovTggp.method: MetaCurate evolves executable trajectory filters starting from a blank filter by comparing filter rankings against pairwise LLM-judge preferences. Disagreements drive joint revisions of the filter's rules, rubric, and aggregation policy, producing a pointwise filter that requires pairwise comparisons only during search.
COPDovTggp.key_idea: Revises a filter's rules, rubric, and aggregation policy from disagreements with pairwise LLM-judge preferences to produce a standalone pointwise trajectory scorer.
COPDovTggp.evidence: Controlled SFT experiments on an uncurated trajectory pool and the Nemotron v3 SWE dataset against random selection and hand-authored filtering.

xRzdkrfcp1.one_liner: Evaluates and trains LLM scientific state abstractions using certified quotient-preserving re-encodings of dynamical systems.
xRzdkrfcp1.problem: Repairing LLM scientific agent failures in one representation often fails to transfer because the model misidentifies which state distinctions actually matter.
xRzdkrfcp1.method: SciQuotient asks LLMs to construct the coarsest exact state abstraction preserving future target observations of finite dynamical systems. Using certified quotient-preserving transformations that vary irrelevant state representations without changing the exact abstraction, it diagnoses hidden failures and trains models on equivalent failures across multiple representations.
xRzdkrfcp1.key_idea: Applies certified quotient-preserving transformations to finite dynamical systems to test and train exact scientific state abstractions across equivalent representations.
xRzdkrfcp1.evidence: Evaluated across several LLM families comparing single-representation versus representation-diverse failure training.

zMMgzhRHqR.one_liner: Refines tutorial-video GUI trajectories via action-family verification and adds a multiple-choice offline checkpoint diagnostic.
zMMgzhRHqR.problem: Software tutorial videos underdetermine the actions causing visual transitions, and failed online GUI rollouts conflate action selection errors with execution errors.
zMMgzhRHqR.method: GUIVista revisits uncertain video action proposals using transition evidence and action-family verification to filter grounded multi-turn mid-training trajectories. For offline diagnosis, it tests checkpoints by having them select the successful action among plausible alternatives in the same GUI context.
zMMgzhRHqR.key_idea: Verifies uncertain video-derived actions with transition evidence and action-family checks for mid-training, and diagnoses checkpoints via multiple-choice action selection.
zMMgzhRHqR.evidence: Evaluated on action recovery, downstream SFT on OSWorld (AVG@4), and checkpoint correlation between the offline diagnostic and post-SFT OSWorld performance.
zMMgzhRHqR.claimed_gains: Improves video action-type/full-action accuracy from 24.75%/8.80% to 50.42%/31.29%, raises OSWorld AVG@4 from 18.40% to 21.75%, and correlates with post-SFT OSWorld at Pearson r=0.9252 and Spearman rho=1.0000.

ymk7OpPLY8.one_liner: Achieves missing-modality segmentation robustness architecturally via low-mixing-init token fusion and pairwise low-rank adapters.
ymk7OpPLY8.problem: Multimodal semantic segmentation models degrade when deployed with arbitrary subsets of sensors missing at test time.
ymk7OpPLY8.method: Adapted Mixture of Modalities (A-MoM) builds missing-modality robustness into the architecture without auxiliary losses or training tricks. It combines token-level context-dependent mixing, an initialization keeping cross-modal mixing low by default, and low-rank adapters translating features between modality pairs.
ymk7OpPLY8.key_idea: Combines context-dependent token mixing initialized near zero with pairwise low-rank modality translation adapters to preserve segmentation accuracy on any modality subset.
ymk7OpPLY8.evidence: Evaluated across 4 semantic segmentation datasets spanning 8 modalities, including MCubeS.
ymk7OpPLY8.claimed_gains: Improves average robustness score by 1.5 and all-modalities score by 0.7 across 4 datasets, retaining on average 92.7% of subset-specialized A-MoM mIoU on MCubeS.

rghtSbh5Ut.one_liner: Gates MARL policy regularization between an online pseudo-expert on desirable trajectories and max-entropy exploration otherwise.
rghtSbh5Ut.problem: Entropy-regularized MARL gives weak guidance for complex cooperative behaviors, while behavior cloning requires offline expert demonstrations unavailable online.
rghtSbh5Ut.method: Balanced Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (BMARL) learns a pseudo-expert online from desirable trajectories and applies a desirability-gated hybrid divergence objective. On desirable trajectories it regularizes the policy toward the pseudo-expert prior, and on undesirable trajectories it reverts to maximum-entropy exploration.
rghtSbh5Ut.key_idea: Switches per trajectory between regularizing toward an online-learned pseudo-expert on desirable rollouts and maximum-entropy exploration on undesirable rollouts.
rghtSbh5Ut.evidence: Theoretical policy evaluation and improvement analyses plus experiments across dense- and sparse-reward MARL tasks.

4Feb9juVnH.one_liner: Accelerates Looped Transformer inference training-free via token-sparse updates, sparse attention, and KV-residual quantization.
4Feb9juVnH.problem: Repeated loops in Looped Transformers multiply forward FLOPs and per-loop KV-cache memory, eroding practical inference efficiency at high loop counts and long contexts.
4Feb9juVnH.method: FlashLoop exploits three cross-loop redundancies without retraining: concentrating updates on tokens with non-trivial state changes, attending over a sparse stable set of key columns, and low-bit quantizing KV residuals between adjacent loops.
4Feb9juVnH.key_idea: Reduces cross-loop compute and memory via token-sparse state updates, stable sparse key-column attention, and low-bit quantization of inter-loop KV residuals.
4Feb9juVnH.evidence: Evaluated across five Ouro and Huginn Looped Transformer variants.
4Feb9juVnH.claimed_gains: Achieves 1.52-1.64x end-to-end speedup across five Ouro and Huginn variants while largely preserving accuracy.
